SELECT cust_nm, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE signup_dt >= '2022-07-01'

SELECT channel_cd, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30' GROUP BY channel_cd
SELECT sku, SUM(qty) AS total_qty FROM ord_line GROUP BY sku HAVING SUM(qty) > 10
SELECT c.cust_nm, o.ord_id, o.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr o JOIN cust_master c ON o.cust_id = c.cust_id WHERE o.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30' AND o.ord_total_amt > 500
SELECT p.prod_nm, p.list_prc, s.sup_nm FROM prod_catalog p JOIN prod_supplier ps ON p.sku = ps.sku JOIN supplier s ON ps.sup_id = s.sup_id WHERE ps.is_primary = 1 AND ps.lead_days < 10
SELECT c.cust_nm, t.tkt_id FROM support_tkt t JOIN cust_master c ON t.cust_id = c.cust_id WHERE t.opened_ts >= '2026-04-01' AND t.opened_ts < '2026-05-01' AND t.sev_lvl IN (1, 2)
SELECT w.wh_nm, i.sku, i.on_hand_qty FROM warehouse w JOIN inventory i ON w.wh_id = i.wh_id WHERE w.region_cd = 'NA'
SELECT categ_cd, prod_nm, list_prc, rnk FROM (SELECT categ_cd, prod_nm, list_prc, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY categ_cd ORDER BY list_prc DESC) AS rnk FROM prod_catalog) t WHERE rnk <= 2
SELECT cust_id, ord_dt, ord_id, SUM(ord_total_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY cust_id ORDER BY ord_dt, ord_id) AS running_total FROM ord_hdr ORDER BY cust_id, ord_dt

SELECT cust_id, ord_dt AS current_ord_dt, LAG(ord_dt) OVER (PARTITION BY cust_id ORDER BY ord_dt, ord_id) AS previous_ord_dt, DATEDIFF(ord_dt, LAG(ord_dt) OVER (PARTITION BY cust_id ORDER BY ord_dt, ord_id)) AS days_gap FROM ord_hdr ORDER BY cust_id, ord_dt
SELECT l.ord_id, l.sku, (l.unit_prc * l.qty) AS line_amt, (l.unit_prc * l.qty) * 100.0 / SUM(l.unit_prc * l.qty) OVER (PARTITION BY l.ord_id) AS pct_share FROM ord_line l

SELECT channel_cd, ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM (SELECT channel_cd, ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel_cd ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id ASC) AS rn FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-12-31') t WHERE rn = 1
SELECT cust_id, MIN(ord_dt) AS first_ord_dt, MAX(ord_dt) AS last_ord_dt FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY cust_id
SELECT ord_id, pay_id, paid_ts, rn FROM (SELECT ord_id, pay_id, paid_ts, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ord_id ORDER BY paid_ts ASC, pay_id ASC) AS rn FROM payment) t WHERE rn = 1
SELECT cust_id, month_dt, segment_cd, LAG(segment_cd) OVER (PARTITION BY cust_id ORDER BY month_dt) AS prev_segment_cd FROM cust_segment_hist

SELECT w.wh_id, w.wh_nm, SUM(i.on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand FROM warehouse w JOIN inventory i ON w.wh_id = i.wh_id WHERE w.region_cd = 'NA' GROUP BY w.wh_id, w.wh_nm ORDER BY total_on_hand DESC, w.wh_id ASC
SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' ORDER BY list_prc DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE region_cd = 'AP' AND is_actv = 1 AND signup_dt >= '2022-07-01' ORDER BY signup_dt ASC, cust_id ASC
SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt, currency_cd FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(*) AS ord_count FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY ord_count DESC, channel_cd ASC
SELECT ord_id, line_no, sku, qty, unit_prc FROM ord_line WHERE ord_id = 'O-5001' ORDER BY line_no ASC
SELECT sup_id, sup_nm, country FROM supplier WHERE country IN ('US', 'CA') ORDER BY sup_nm ASC
SELECT sku, wh_id, on_hand_qty FROM (SELECT sku, wh_id, on_hand_qty, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sku ORDER BY on_hand_qty DESC) as rnk FROM inventory) t WHERE rnk = 1 ORDER BY sku ASC
SELECT mv_id, sku, mv_ts, mv_type, qty, SUM(qty) OVER (ORDER BY mv_ts ASC, mv_id ASC) AS running_total FROM inv_move WHERE wh_id = 'W1' ORDER BY mv_ts ASC, mv_id ASC
SELECT wh_id, mv_id, sku, mv_ts, DATEDIFF(mv_ts, LAG(mv_ts) OVER (ORDER BY mv_ts ASC, mv_id ASC)) AS days_since_prev FROM inv_move WHERE wh_id = 'W1' ORDER BY mv_ts ASC, mv_id ASC
SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt, (ord_total_amt / SUM(ord_total_amt) OVER ()) * 100 AS pct_contribution FROM ord_hdr WHERE currency_cd = 'USD' ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id ASC

SELECT cust_id, ord_id, ord_dt, CASE WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cust_id ORDER BY ord_dt ASC, ord_id ASC) = 1 THEN 'First' WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cust_id ORDER BY ord_dt DESC, ord_id DESC) = 1 THEN 'Last' ELSE 'Middle' END AS order_type FROM (SELECT cust_id, ord_id, ord_dt FROM ord_hdr) x ORDER BY cust_id ASC, ord_dt ASC
SELECT rfd_id, ord_id, req_dt, rfd_amt FROM refund_req WHERE req_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND req_dt <= '2025-12-31' ORDER BY rfd_amt DESC, rfd_id ASC LIMIT 5
SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(*) AS tkt_count FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY tkt_count DESC, categ_cd ASC
SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'HOM' AND disc_flag = 1 ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku ASC
SELECT promo_id, promo_nm, disc_pct, starts_dt FROM promo WHERE starts_dt >= '2025-11-01' AND disc_pct >= 15.00 ORDER BY disc_pct DESC, promo_id ASC
SELECT sup_id, sku, lead_days, is_primary FROM prod_supplier WHERE lead_days = 7 ORDER BY sku ASC, sup_id ASC
SELECT wh_id, wh_nm, region_cd FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd = 'EU' ORDER BY wh_nm ASC
SELECT code_type, code_val, code_desc FROM code_lookup WHERE code_type = 'REFUND_REASON' ORDER BY code_val ASC
SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, tier_cd FROM cust_master WHERE tier_cd = 'P' ORDER BY cust_nm ASC, cust_id ASC
SELECT carrier_cd, COUNT(*) AS shipment_count FROM shipment GROUP BY carrier_cd ORDER BY shipment_count DESC, carrier_cd ASC
SELECT pay_id, ord_id, pay_amt, currency_cd FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' AND method_cd = 'CC' AND pay_amt > 100 ORDER BY pay_amt DESC, pay_id ASC
SELECT wh_id, sku, on_hand_qty FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt
SELECT ship_id, ord_id, ship_dt FROM shipment WHERE wh_id = 'W1' AND ship_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ship_dt <= '2026-01-31'
SELECT currency_cd, SUM(pay_amt) AS total_successful_cc_payments FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' AND method_cd = 'CC' GROUP BY currency_cd
SELECT categ_cd, AVG(list_prc) AS avg_list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE disc_flag = 0 GROUP BY categ_cd
SELECT s.carrier_cd, COUNT(*) AS shipment_count FROM shipment s JOIN ord_hdr o ON s.ord_id = o.ord_id WHERE o.channel_cd = 'WEB' GROUP BY s.carrier_cd
SELECT w.wh_id, w.wh_nm, SUM(ABS(m.qty)) AS total_abs_qty FROM warehouse w LEFT JOIN inv_move m ON w.wh_id = m.wh_id AND m.mv_type = 'OUT' GROUP BY w.wh_id, w.wh_nm

SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm, SUM(l.qty) AS total_units FROM prod_catalog p JOIN ord_line l ON p.sku = l.sku JOIN ord_hdr o ON l.ord_id = o.ord_id WHERE p.categ_cd = 'ELC' AND o.ord_dt >= '2026-04-01' GROUP BY p.sku, p.prod_nm
SELECT t1.wh_id, t1.sku, t1.on_hand_qty FROM inventory t1 WHERE t1.on_hand_qty = (SELECT MAX(t2.on_hand_qty) FROM inventory t2 WHERE t2.wh_id = t1.wh_id) ORDER BY t1.wh_id ASC, t1.sku ASC
SELECT mv_id, sku, wh_id, mv_ts, mv_type, qty, SUM(qty) OVER (ORDER BY mv_ts ASC, mv_id ASC) AS cumulative_qty FROM inv_move WHERE sku = 'ELC-026' AND wh_id = 'W1'
SELECT ship_id, wh_id, ship_dt, deliv_dt, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY wh_id ORDER BY deliv_dt ASC) AS rnk FROM shipment WHERE deliv_dt IS NOT NULL

SELECT pay_id, method_cd, paid_ts, TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, LAG(paid_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY method_cd ORDER BY paid_ts ASC), paid_ts) AS gap_hours FROM payment WHERE currency_cd = 'USD' AND pay_status = 'S'
SELECT l.ord_id, l.line_no, l.sku, (l.qty * l.unit_prc) / SUM(l.qty * l.unit_prc) OVER (PARTITION BY l.ord_id) * 100 AS pct_contribution FROM ord_line l
SELECT wh_id, MIN(mv_ts) AS earliest_ts, MAX(mv_ts) AS latest_ts FROM inv_move GROUP BY wh_id
SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm, p.categ_cd, p.list_prc FROM prod_catalog p WHERE p.list_prc > (SELECT AVG(p2.list_prc) FROM prod_catalog p2 WHERE p2.categ_cd = p.categ_cd)
SELECT channel_cd, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_amount, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY channel_cd
SELECT categ_cd, prod_nm, list_prc FROM (SELECT categ_cd, prod_nm, list_prc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY categ_cd ORDER BY list_prc DESC, prod_nm ASC) AS rn FROM prod_catalog) t WHERE rn <= 2

SELECT s.ship_id, s.ord_id, s.wh_id, s.carrier_cd, s.ship_dt, s.deliv_dt, s.ship_status FROM shipment s JOIN (SELECT wh_id, AVG(DATEDIFF(deliv_dt, ship_dt)) AS avg_days FROM shipment WHERE deliv_dt IS NOT NULL GROUP BY wh_id) a ON s.wh_id = a.wh_id WHERE s.deliv_dt IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(s.deliv_dt, s.ship_dt) < a.avg_days
SELECT method_cd, COUNT(*) AS total_attempts, SUM(CASE WHEN pay_status = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_attempts FROM payment GROUP BY method_cd
SELECT MIN(ord_total_amt) AS min_amt, MAX(ord_total_amt) AS max_amt, AVG(ord_total_amt) AS avg_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE currency_cd = 'USD'
SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt, SUM(ord_total_amt) OVER (ORDER BY ord_dt ASC, ord_id ASC) AS running_total FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'STR'
SELECT wh_id, COUNT(DISTINCT sku) AS distinct_products FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id
SELECT ord_status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY ord_status
SELECT carrier_cd, COUNT(*) AS shipment_count FROM shipment GROUP BY carrier_cd HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

SELECT p.promo_cd, p.promo_nm, COUNT(op.ord_id) AS order_count FROM promo p LEFT JOIN ord_promo op ON p.promo_id = op.promo_id GROUP BY p.promo_id, p.promo_cd, p.promo_nm ORDER BY order_count DESC, p.promo_cd ASC
SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND region_cd = 'NA' AND signup_dt > '2022-07-01' ORDER BY signup_dt ASC, cust_id ASC
SELECT session_id, evt_ts, evt_type FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59' ORDER BY evt_ts ASC, session_id ASC
SELECT channel_cd, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_amount FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY total_amount DESC
SELECT segment_cd, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE month_dt >= '2026-07-01' AND month_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY segment_cd ORDER BY record_count DESC
SELECT ord_status, AVG(ord_total_amt) AS avg_amount FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' GROUP BY ord_status ORDER BY avg_amount DESC
SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, tier_cd FROM cust_master WHERE tier_cd = 'P' AND region_cd = 'EU' ORDER BY cust_nm ASC, cust_id ASC;
SELECT promo_cd, disc_pct FROM promo WHERE starts_dt >= '2026-01-01' ORDER BY disc_pct DESC, promo_cd ASC;
SELECT ord_id, cust_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_total_amt > 500.00 AND currency_cd = 'USD' ORDER BY ord_dt DESC, ord_id ASC;
SELECT t1.channel_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.cust_id) FROM ord_hdr t1 GROUP BY t1.channel_cd ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT t1.cust_id) DESC;
SELECT tier_cd, COUNT(*) AS total_customers, SUM(is_actv) AS active_customers FROM cust_master GROUP BY tier_cd ORDER BY total_customers DESC;

SELECT p.promo_nm, p.starts_dt, p.ends_dt, COUNT(op.ord_id) AS total_orders FROM promo p JOIN ord_promo op ON p.promo_id = op.promo_id WHERE p.disc_pct >= 15.00 GROUP BY p.promo_id, p.promo_nm, p.starts_dt, p.ends_dt ORDER BY total_orders DESC;

SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm, SUM(o.ord_total_amt) AS total_spend FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm HAVING SUM(o.ord_total_amt) > 1000.00 ORDER BY total_spend DESC;
SELECT month_dt, COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) AS distinct_customers FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE month_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND month_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY month_dt ORDER BY month_dt ASC;
SELECT session_id, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM web_event WHERE evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts < '2025-12-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY session_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 2 ORDER BY event_count DESC;

SELECT c.tier_cd, AVG(o.ord_total_amt) AS avg_order_amt, MAX(o.ord_total_amt) AS max_order_amt FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY c.tier_cd ORDER BY avg_order_amt DESC;

WITH ranked_orders AS (SELECT channel_cd, ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel_cd ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id ASC) as rn FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31') SELECT channel_cd, ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM ranked_orders WHERE rn <= 2 ORDER BY channel_cd ASC, ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id ASC;

SELECT cust_id, ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt, SUM(ord_total_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY cust_id ORDER BY ord_dt ASC, ord_id ASC) AS cumulative_total FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' ORDER BY cust_id ASC, ord_dt ASC, ord_id ASC;

SELECT cust_id, ord_id, ord_dt, prev_ord_dt, DATEDIFF(ord_dt, prev_ord_dt) AS days_between FROM (SELECT cust_id, ord_id, ord_dt, LAG(ord_dt) OVER (PARTITION BY cust_id ORDER BY ord_dt ASC, ord_id ASC) AS prev_ord_dt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31') sub ORDER BY cust_id ASC, ord_dt ASC, ord_id ASC;

WITH promo_rev AS (SELECT p.promo_cd, p.promo_nm, SUM(o.ord_total_amt) AS rev FROM promo p JOIN ord_promo op ON p.promo_id = op.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr o ON op.ord_id = o.ord_id WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY p.promo_id, p.promo_cd, p.promo_nm), total_rev AS (SELECT SUM(rev) AS grand_total FROM promo_rev) SELECT pr.promo_cd, pr.promo_nm, pr.rev AS promotion_order_revenue, (pr.rev / tr.grand_total) * 100 AS percentage_of_total_revenue FROM promo_rev pr CROSS JOIN total_rev tr ORDER BY percentage_of_total_revenue DESC;

SELECT cust_id, MIN(evt_ts) AS first_event_ts, (SELECT evt_type FROM web_event w2 WHERE w2.cust_id = w1.cust_id AND w2.evt_ts >= '2025-12-01 00:00:00' AND w2.evt_ts < '2026-01-01 00:00:00' ORDER BY w2.evt_ts ASC, w2.evt_id ASC LIMIT 1) AS first_event_type, MAX(evt_ts) AS last_event_ts, (SELECT evt_type FROM web_event w3 WHERE w3.cust_id = w1.cust_id AND w3.evt_ts >= '2025-12-01 00:00:00' AND w3.evt_ts < '2026-01-01 00:00:00' ORDER BY w3.evt_ts DESC, w3.evt_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_event_type FROM web_event w1 WHERE cust_id IS NOT NULL AND evt_ts >= '2025-12-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts < '2026-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY cust_id ORDER BY cust_id ASC;

WITH region_spend AS (SELECT c.region_cd, c.cust_id, SUM(o.ord_total_amt) AS total_spend FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY c.region_cd, c.cust_id), ranked AS (SELECT region_cd, cust_id, total_spend, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region_cd ORDER BY total_spend DESC) as rnk FROM region_spend) SELECT region_cd, cust_id, total_spend, rnk AS rank FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 3 ORDER BY region_cd ASC, rank ASC, total_spend DESC;

SELECT cust_id, segment_cd, MIN(month_dt) AS earliest_month_date, MAX(month_dt) AS latest_month_date FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE month_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND month_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY cust_id, segment_cd ORDER BY cust_id ASC, segment_cd ASC;

WITH monthly_orders AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS month_str, ord_id, cust_id, ord_total_amt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id ASC) as rn FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31') SELECT month_str AS month, ord_id, cust_id, ord_total_amt FROM monthly_orders WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY month ASC;
SELECT sku, wh_id, on_hand_qty FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W1';
SELECT sup_nm, country FROM supplier WHERE country = 'US';
SELECT prod_nm, list_prc, categ_cd FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND disc_flag = 0;
SELECT wh_nm, region_cd FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd = 'NA';
SELECT sku, lead_days FROM prod_supplier WHERE lead_days > 30;
SELECT sku, mv_ts, qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'IN' AND mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND mv_ts < '2025-11-01 00:00:00';
SELECT t1.sku, t2.prod_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.sup_id) AS supplier_count FROM prod_supplier t1 JOIN prod_catalog t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku GROUP BY t1.sku, t2.prod_nm HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t1.sup_id) > 1

SELECT t1.sup_nm, COUNT(t2.sku) AS primary_prod_count FROM supplier t1 JOIN prod_supplier t2 ON t1.sup_id = t2.sup_id WHERE t2.is_primary = 1 GROUP BY t1.sup_id, t1.sup_nm ORDER BY primary_prod_count DESC
SELECT categ_cd, AVG(list_prc) AS avg_list_prc FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd HAVING AVG(list_prc) > 50
SELECT sku, wh_id, on_hand_qty FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty < reorder_pt
SELECT t2.sup_nm, t1.sku, t1.lead_days FROM prod_supplier t1 JOIN supplier t2 ON t1.sup_id = t2.sup_id WHERE t1.lead_days > (SELECT AVG(lead_days) FROM prod_supplier)
SELECT wh_id, sku, on_hand_qty, rk FROM (SELECT wh_id, sku, on_hand_qty, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY wh_id ORDER BY on_hand_qty DESC) AS rk FROM inventory) t WHERE rk <= 3

SELECT t1.sku, t1.wh_id, t1.on_hand_qty, (t1.on_hand_qty * 100.0 / t2.tot_qty) AS percentage_share FROM inventory t1 JOIN (SELECT sku, SUM(on_hand_qty) AS tot_qty FROM inventory GROUP BY sku) t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku
SELECT sup_id, sku, lead_days FROM (SELECT sup_id, sku, lead_days, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sup_id ORDER BY lead_days DESC, sku ASC) AS rn FROM prod_supplier) t WHERE rn = 1

SELECT t1.prod_nm, t1.categ_cd, t1.list_prc FROM prod_catalog t1 JOIN (SELECT categ_cd, AVG(list_prc) AS avg_prc FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd) t2 ON t1.categ_cd = t2.categ_cd WHERE t1.list_prc > t2.avg_prc
SELECT wh_id, sku, mv_ts FROM (SELECT wh_id, sku, mv_ts, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wh_id ORDER BY mv_ts ASC, mv_id ASC) AS rn FROM inv_move) t WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY wh_id
SELECT wh_id, sku, mv_ts FROM (SELECT wh_id, sku, mv_ts, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wh_id ORDER BY mv_ts DESC, mv_id DESC) AS rn FROM inv_move) t WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY wh_id
SELECT t1.sku, t1.wh_id, t1.on_hand_qty FROM inventory t1 JOIN (SELECT wh_id, AVG(on_hand_qty) AS avg_qty FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id) t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id WHERE t1.on_hand_qty > t2.avg_qty
SELECT categ_cd, prod_nm, list_prc, rk FROM (SELECT categ_cd, prod_nm, list_prc, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY categ_cd ORDER BY list_prc DESC) AS rk FROM prod_catalog) t WHERE rk <= 2

SELECT t1.sup_id, t1.sku, t1.lead_days, (t1.lead_days - t2.min_lead) AS lead_days_diff FROM prod_supplier t1 JOIN (SELECT sup_id, MIN(lead_days) AS min_lead FROM prod_supplier GROUP BY sup_id) t2 ON t1.sup_id = t2.sup_id
SELECT t1.sku, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.sup_id) AS supplier_count FROM prod_supplier t1 GROUP BY t1.sku HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t1.sup_id) > 1 AND SUM(CASE WHEN t1.lead_days > 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(oh.ord_dt, '%Y-%m-01') AS month_start, SUM(oh.ord_total_amt * fx.rate_to_usd) AS total_usd FROM ord_hdr oh JOIN fx_rate fx ON oh.currency_cd = fx.currency_cd AND oh.ord_dt = fx.eff_dt WHERE oh.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(oh.ord_dt, '%Y-%m-01') ORDER BY month_start
SELECT channel_cd, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_ord_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-03-31' GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY total_ord_amt DESC
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%x-%v') AS year_week, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-03-31' GROUP BY year_week ORDER BY year_week

SELECT ol.sku, SUM(ol.qty) AS total_qty FROM ord_hdr oh JOIN ord_line ol ON oh.ord_id = ol.ord_id WHERE oh.ord_status = 'D' AND oh.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31' GROUP BY ol.sku ORDER BY total_qty DESC, ol.sku ASC LIMIT 5

SELECT QUARTER(oh.ord_dt) AS quarter_num, SUM(oh.ord_total_amt * fx.rate_to_usd) AS total_revenue_usd FROM ord_hdr oh JOIN fx_rate fx ON oh.currency_cd = fx.currency_cd AND oh.ord_dt = fx.eff_dt WHERE oh.ord_dt BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY QUARTER(oh.ord_dt) ORDER BY quarter_num

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(h.ord_dt, '%Y-%m-01') AS month_start, SUM(l.qty) AS total_qty FROM ord_hdr h JOIN ord_line l ON h.ord_id = l.ord_id JOIN prod_catalog p ON l.sku = p.sku WHERE p.categ_cd = 'ELC' AND h.ord_dt >= '2025-10-01' AND h.ord_dt <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(h.ord_dt, '%Y-%m-01') ORDER BY month_start ASC
SELECT wh_id, mv_type, SUM(qty) AS sum_qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND mv_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY wh_id, mv_type ORDER BY wh_id ASC, mv_type ASC
SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE list_prc BETWEEN 30.00 AND 80.00 ORDER BY list_prc ASC
SELECT w.wh_id, w.wh_nm, COUNT(i.sku) AS inventory_count FROM warehouse w LEFT JOIN inventory i ON w.wh_id = i.wh_id GROUP BY w.wh_id, w.wh_nm ORDER BY w.wh_id ASC

SELECT sku, SUM(qty) AS total_net_qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'ADJ' AND mv_ts >= '2025-10-02 00:00:00' AND mv_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY sku ORDER BY total_net_qty DESC, sku ASC

SELECT h.channel_cd, SUM(l.qty) AS total_qty FROM ord_hdr h JOIN ord_line l ON h.ord_id = l.ord_id WHERE h.ord_dt >= '2025-11-01' AND h.ord_dt <= '2025-11-30' GROUP BY h.channel_cd ORDER BY total_qty DESC

SELECT '2025-11-01' AS week_start, sku, SUM(qty) AS total_qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'IN' AND mv_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND mv_ts < '2025-11-08 00:00:00' GROUP BY sku UNION ALL SELECT '2025-11-08' AS week_start, sku, SUM(qty) AS total_qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'IN' AND mv_ts >= '2025-11-08 00:00:00' AND mv_ts < '2025-11-15 00:00:00' GROUP BY sku UNION ALL SELECT '2025-11-15' AS week_start, sku, SUM(qty) AS total_qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'IN' AND mv_ts >= '2025-11-15 00:00:00' AND mv_ts < '2025-11-22 00:00:00' GROUP BY sku UNION ALL SELECT '2025-11-22' AS week_start, sku, SUM(qty) AS total_qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'IN' AND mv_ts >= '2025-11-22 00:00:00' AND mv_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY sku ORDER BY week_start ASC, sku ASC
SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE disc_flag = 1 AND categ_cd = 'OFC' ORDER BY sku ASC
SELECT sup_id, sup_nm FROM supplier WHERE country = 'US' ORDER BY sup_nm ASC

SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_status = 'D' AND channel_cd = 'APP' AND ord_dt = '2026-04-03' ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id ASC
SELECT prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'KIT' AND list_prc > 80.00 ORDER BY list_prc DESC, prod_nm ASC
SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE currency_cd = 'GBP' AND ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30'
SELECT ord_id, line_no, disc_pct FROM ord_line WHERE ord_id = 'O-5024' AND disc_pct > 0

SELECT channel_cd, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_amount FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_status = 'D' AND ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY total_amount DESC

SELECT h.ord_id, c.cust_nm, h.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr h JOIN cust_master c ON h.cust_id = c.cust_id WHERE h.currency_cd = 'USD' AND h.ord_total_amt > 500 AND h.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31' ORDER BY h.ord_total_amt DESC
SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm, SUM(l.qty) AS total_qty FROM ord_line l JOIN prod_catalog p ON l.sku = p.sku WHERE l.qty >= 4 GROUP BY p.sku, p.prod_nm ORDER BY total_qty DESC, p.sku ASC

SELECT c.tier_cd, AVG(p.list_prc) AS avg_list_prc FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id JOIN ord_line l ON o.ord_id = l.ord_id JOIN prod_catalog p ON l.sku = p.sku WHERE c.is_actv = 1 GROUP BY c.tier_cd ORDER BY avg_list_prc DESC

SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm, COUNT(o.ord_id) AS web_order_count FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE o.channel_cd = 'WEB' GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm HAVING COUNT(o.ord_id) > 1 ORDER BY web_order_count DESC
SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(*) AS expensive_count FROM prod_catalog WHERE list_prc > 100.00 AND disc_flag = 0 GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY expensive_count DESC

SELECT l.ord_id, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM ord_line l JOIN ord_hdr h ON l.ord_id = h.ord_id WHERE h.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30' GROUP BY l.ord_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ORDER BY line_count DESC, l.ord_id ASC
SELECT ord_id, sku, qty, unit_prc, (qty * unit_prc) AS net_line_value FROM ord_line WHERE (qty * unit_prc) > 300.00 ORDER BY net_line_value DESC, ord_id ASC

SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm, SUM(l.qty * l.unit_prc) AS total_revenue FROM prod_catalog p JOIN ord_line l ON p.sku = l.sku GROUP BY p.sku, p.prod_nm HAVING SUM(l.qty * l.unit_prc) > 500.00 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm, SUM(o.ord_total_amt) AS total_spent FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE o.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-01-31' GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm HAVING COUNT(o.ord_id) >= 2 ORDER BY total_spent DESC, c.cust_id ASC

SELECT o.channel_cd, COUNT(l.ord_id) AS total_lines, SUM(CASE WHEN l.disc_pct > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS discounted_lines FROM ord_hdr o JOIN ord_line l ON o.ord_id = l.ord_id GROUP BY o.channel_cd ORDER BY (SUM(CASE WHEN l.disc_pct > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(l.ord_id)) DESC, o.channel_cd ASC

SELECT c.tier_cd, COUNT(o.ord_id) AS total_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN o.ord_total_amt > 300.00 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS large_order_count FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id GROUP BY c.tier_cd ORDER BY large_order_count DESC, c.tier_cd ASC

SELECT c.region_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT c.cust_id) AS active_cust_count, AVG(p.list_prc) AS avg_list_prc FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id JOIN ord_line l ON o.ord_id = l.ord_id JOIN prod_catalog p ON l.sku = p.sku WHERE c.is_actv = 1 GROUP BY c.region_cd ORDER BY avg_list_prc DESC

SELECT h.ord_id, h.ord_dt, c.cust_nm FROM ord_hdr h JOIN cust_master c ON h.cust_id = c.cust_id WHERE h.ord_total_amt > 500.00 AND h.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30' ORDER BY h.ord_dt DESC, h.ord_id ASC

SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm, SUM(t2.ord_total_amt) AS total_amt FROM cust_master t1 JOIN ord_hdr t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.tier_cd = 'P' AND t2.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND t2.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm ORDER BY total_amt DESC

SELECT t2.region_cd, SUM(t1.ord_total_amt) AS total_amt FROM ord_hdr t1 JOIN cust_master t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.ord_status = 'C' AND t1.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND t1.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY t2.region_cd ORDER BY total_amt DESC

SELECT t2.cust_nm, t1.ord_id, t3.pay_amt FROM ord_hdr t1 JOIN cust_master t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id JOIN payment t3 ON t1.ord_id = t3.ord_id WHERE t1.channel_cd = 'WEB' AND t3.pay_status = 'S' AND t3.paid_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND t3.paid_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59' ORDER BY t3.pay_amt DESC

SELECT t1.emp_nm, AVG(t2.rfd_amt) AS avg_amt FROM emp t1 JOIN refund_req t2 ON t1.emp_id = t2.approver_emp_id WHERE t2.reason_cd = 'DMG' AND t2.req_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND t2.req_dt <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY t1.emp_id, t1.emp_nm ORDER BY avg_amt DESC

SELECT t1.cust_nm, t1.tier_cd, COUNT(t2.ord_id) AS ret_cnt FROM cust_master t1 JOIN ord_hdr t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.ord_status = 'R' GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm, t1.tier_cd HAVING COUNT(t2.ord_id) > 1 ORDER BY ret_cnt DESC

SELECT t1.emp_nm, t1.dept_cd, COUNT(t2.tkt_id) AS tkt_cnt FROM emp t1 JOIN support_tkt t2 ON t1.emp_id = t2.assigned_emp_id WHERE t1.dept_cd = 'SUPP' GROUP BY t1.emp_id, t1.emp_nm, t1.dept_cd HAVING COUNT(t2.tkt_id) >= 3 ORDER BY tkt_cnt DESC

SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(*) AS fast_cnt FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' AND closed_ts IS NOT NULL AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, opened_ts, closed_ts) < 24 GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY fast_cnt DESC

SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_status = 'C' GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY order_count DESC
SELECT promo_nm, promo_cd, disc_pct FROM promo WHERE disc_pct > 15.00 AND starts_dt <= '2026-12-31' AND ends_dt >= '2026-01-01' ORDER BY disc_pct DESC

SELECT t1.cust_nm, t1.signup_dt, t1.region_cd FROM cust_master t1 JOIN cust_segment_hist t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.signup_dt >= '2022-07-01' AND t2.month_dt = '2025-11-01' AND t2.segment_cd = 'NEW' ORDER BY t1.signup_dt ASC
SELECT session_id, cust_id, ord_id FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND ord_id IS NOT NULL AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59' ORDER BY session_id ASC

SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm, COUNT(o.ord_id) AS order_cnt FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE c.is_actv = 1 GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm HAVING COUNT(o.ord_id) > 1 ORDER BY order_cnt DESC, c.cust_nm ASC;

SELECT c.cust_id, COUNT(w.evt_id) AS checkout_cnt FROM cust_master c JOIN web_event w ON c.cust_id = w.cust_id WHERE w.evt_type = 'CHECKOUT' AND w.channel_cd = 'WEB' AND w.evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND w.evt_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY c.cust_id ORDER BY checkout_cnt DESC;

SELECT p.promo_nm, SUM(o.ord_total_amt) AS total_revenue FROM promo p JOIN ord_promo op ON p.promo_id = op.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr o ON op.ord_id = o.ord_id WHERE p.disc_pct >= 20.00 GROUP BY p.promo_id, p.promo_nm ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE currency_cd = 'USD' AND ord_total_amt > 400.00 AND ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30' AND ord_id NOT IN (SELECT ord_id FROM ord_promo) ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC;
SELECT ord_id, COUNT(promo_id) AS promo_cnt FROM ord_promo GROUP BY ord_id HAVING COUNT(promo_id) > 1 ORDER BY promo_cnt DESC, ord_id ASC;

SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT w.session_id) AS session_cnt FROM cust_master c JOIN web_event w ON c.cust_id = w.cust_id WHERE w.evt_type = 'PURCHASE' GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT w.session_id) >= 2 ORDER BY session_cnt DESC;

SELECT p.promo_cd, p.promo_nm, COUNT(op.ord_id) AS ord_cnt FROM promo p JOIN ord_promo op ON p.promo_id = op.promo_id GROUP BY p.promo_id, p.promo_cd, p.promo_nm HAVING COUNT(op.ord_id) >= 3 ORDER BY ord_cnt DESC;

SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT s.segment_cd) AS segment_cnt FROM cust_master c JOIN cust_segment_hist s ON c.cust_id = s.cust_id GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.segment_cd) >= 2 ORDER BY segment_cnt DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN web_event w ON c.cust_id = w.cust_id WHERE w.channel_cd IN ('WEB', 'APP') GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN w.channel_cd = 'WEB' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN w.channel_cd = 'APP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY c.cust_nm ASC;

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.ord_dt, '%Y-%m-01') AS promo_month, SUM(o.ord_total_amt) AS total_promo_revenue FROM ord_hdr o JOIN ord_promo op ON o.ord_id = op.ord_id WHERE o.currency_cd = 'USD' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.ord_dt, '%Y-%m-01') HAVING SUM(o.ord_total_amt) > 500.00 ORDER BY total_promo_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE c.is_actv = 1 GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm HAVING COUNT(o.ord_id) > 0 AND COUNT(o.ord_id) = SUM(CASE WHEN o.ord_id IN (SELECT ord_id FROM ord_promo) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ORDER BY c.cust_nm ASC;

SELECT carrier_cd, COUNT(*) AS late_shipment_cnt FROM shipment WHERE wh_id = 'W1' AND ship_dt >= '2025-11-01' AND ship_dt <= '2025-11-30' AND deliv_dt IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(deliv_dt, ship_dt) > 5 GROUP BY carrier_cd ORDER BY late_shipment_cnt DESC, carrier_cd ASC;

SELECT cust_id, COUNT(*) AS high_val_ord_cnt FROM ord_hdr WHERE currency_cd = 'USD' AND ord_total_amt > 500.00 AND channel_cd = 'WEB' AND ord_dt BETWEEN '2025-10-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY cust_id ORDER BY high_val_ord_cnt DESC, cust_id ASC;

SELECT sku, wh_id, SUM(ABS(qty)) AS total_abs_qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND mv_ts <= '2025-10-31 23:59:59' AND ABS(qty) >= 100 GROUP BY sku, wh_id ORDER BY total_abs_qty DESC, sku ASC;
SELECT s.sup_nm, COUNT(ps.sku) AS prod_cnt FROM supplier s JOIN prod_supplier ps ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id WHERE ps.is_primary = 1 GROUP BY s.sup_id, s.sup_nm ORDER BY prod_cnt DESC, s.sup_nm ASC;

SELECT l.sku, SUM(l.qty) AS total_qty FROM ord_hdr h JOIN ord_line l ON h.ord_id = l.ord_id WHERE h.ord_dt BETWEEN '2025-11-01' AND '2025-11-30' AND l.disc_pct >= 15.00 GROUP BY l.sku ORDER BY total_qty DESC, l.sku ASC;

SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(*) AS tkt_cnt FROM support_tkt WHERE sev_lvl = 1 AND opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY tkt_cnt DESC, categ_cd ASC;
SELECT w.wh_nm, COUNT(i.sku) AS item_cnt FROM warehouse w JOIN inventory i ON w.wh_id = i.wh_id WHERE i.on_hand_qty > 500 GROUP BY w.wh_id, w.wh_nm ORDER BY item_cnt DESC, w.wh_nm ASC;
SELECT s.sup_nm, COUNT(ps.sku) AS prod_cnt FROM supplier s JOIN prod_supplier ps ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id WHERE ps.lead_days > 30 GROUP BY s.sup_id, s.sup_nm ORDER BY prod_cnt DESC, s.sup_nm ASC;
SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND list_prc > 75.00 AND disc_flag = 0 ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku ASC;

SELECT c.cust_nm, COUNT(o.ord_id) AS cancelled_cnt FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE c.signup_dt >= '2022-01-01' AND c.signup_dt <= '2022-12-31' AND c.is_actv = 1 AND o.ord_status = 'C' GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm ORDER BY cancelled_cnt DESC, c.cust_nm ASC;

SELECT approver_emp_id, SUM(rfd_amt) AS total_approved_amt FROM refund_req WHERE reason_cd = 'DMG' AND status_cd = 'A' AND decided_dt BETWEEN '2025-12-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY approver_emp_id ORDER BY total_approved_amt DESC, approver_emp_id ASC;

SELECT method_cd, COUNT(*) AS payment_cnt FROM payment WHERE pay_amt > 200.00 AND pay_status = 'S' AND paid_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND paid_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY method_cd ORDER BY payment_cnt DESC, method_cd ASC;
SELECT promo_cd, promo_nm FROM promo WHERE starts_dt <= '2025-11-25' AND ends_dt >= '2025-11-25' ORDER BY promo_nm ASC;

SELECT w.wh_nm, SUM(m.qty) AS total_qty FROM inv_move m JOIN warehouse w ON m.wh_id = w.wh_id WHERE m.mv_type = 'IN' AND m.mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND m.mv_ts < '2025-11-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY w.wh_id, w.wh_nm ORDER BY total_qty DESC, w.wh_nm ASC
SELECT wh_id, sku, on_hand_qty FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W1' AND on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt ORDER BY on_hand_qty ASC, sku ASC

SELECT c.region_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT h.cust_id) AS vip_count FROM cust_segment_hist h JOIN cust_master c ON h.cust_id = c.cust_id WHERE h.month_dt = '2025-12-01' AND h.segment_cd = 'VIP' GROUP BY c.region_cd ORDER BY vip_count DESC, c.region_cd ASC

SELECT cust_id, COUNT(*) AS purchase_count FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND channel_cd = 'WEB' AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts < '2025-12-01 00:00:00' AND cust_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cust_id ORDER BY purchase_count DESC, cust_id ASC
SELECT l.sku, SUM(l.qty * l.unit_prc) AS total_revenue FROM ord_line l GROUP BY l.sku HAVING total_revenue > 1000.00 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, l.sku ASC

SELECT t.categ_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tkt_id) AS tkt_count FROM support_tkt t JOIN tkt_event e ON t.tkt_id = e.tkt_id WHERE e.evt_type = 'ESCAL' AND t.opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND t.opened_ts < '2026-05-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY t.categ_cd ORDER BY tkt_count DESC, t.categ_cd ASC

SELECT o.ord_id, COUNT(p.pay_id) AS pay_count FROM ord_hdr o JOIN payment p ON o.ord_id = p.ord_id WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2025-11-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2025-11-30' GROUP BY o.ord_id HAVING pay_count > 1 ORDER BY pay_count DESC, o.ord_id ASC

SELECT o.ord_id, COUNT(l.line_no) AS line_count FROM ord_hdr o JOIN ord_line l ON o.ord_id = l.ord_id WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2025-11-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2025-11-30' GROUP BY o.ord_id HAVING line_count > 3 ORDER BY line_count DESC, o.ord_id ASC

SELECT e.emp_nm, COUNT(r.rfd_id) AS approval_count FROM emp e JOIN refund_req r ON e.emp_id = r.approver_emp_id WHERE r.status_cd = 'A' GROUP BY e.emp_id, e.emp_nm HAVING approval_count > 2 ORDER BY approval_count DESC, e.emp_nm ASC

SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm, COUNT(o.ord_id) AS total_orders FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE c.is_actv = 1 AND c.region_cd = 'NA' GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm HAVING total_orders > 2 ORDER BY total_orders DESC, c.cust_id ASC
SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND list_prc > (SELECT AVG(list_prc) FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC') ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku ASC

SELECT o.channel_cd, SUM(o.ord_total_amt * f.rate_to_usd) AS total_usd_rev FROM ord_hdr o JOIN fx_rate f ON o.currency_cd = f.currency_cd AND o.ord_dt = f.eff_dt WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY o.channel_cd ORDER BY total_usd_rev DESC
SELECT tier_cd, COUNT(cust_id) AS cust_count FROM cust_master WHERE signup_dt >= '2022-01-01' AND signup_dt <= '2022-12-31' GROUP BY tier_cd ORDER BY cust_count DESC
SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm, MAX(l.unit_prc) AS max_unit_prc FROM ord_line l JOIN prod_catalog p ON l.sku = p.sku WHERE l.qty > 3 GROUP BY p.sku, p.prod_nm ORDER BY max_unit_prc DESC, p.sku ASC

SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' AND o.channel_cd IN ('WEB', 'APP') GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.channel_cd) = 2 ORDER BY c.cust_id ASC

SELECT c.region_cd, AVG(o.ord_total_amt * f.rate_to_usd) AS avg_usd_amt FROM ord_hdr o JOIN cust_master c ON o.cust_id = c.cust_id JOIN fx_rate f ON o.currency_cd = f.currency_cd AND o.ord_dt = f.eff_dt WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-06-30' GROUP BY c.region_cd ORDER BY avg_usd_amt DESC
SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm, SUM(l.qty) AS total_qty FROM ord_line l JOIN prod_catalog p ON l.sku = p.sku GROUP BY p.sku, p.prod_nm ORDER BY total_qty DESC, p.sku ASC LIMIT 5
SELECT tier_cd, COUNT(*) AS total_customers, (SUM(is_actv) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS active_percentage FROM cust_master GROUP BY tier_cd ORDER BY active_percentage DESC

SELECT o.ord_id, o.cust_id, o.ord_dt, COUNT(l.line_no) AS line_count FROM ord_hdr o JOIN ord_line l ON o.ord_id = l.ord_id GROUP BY o.ord_id, o.cust_id, o.ord_dt HAVING line_count > 2 ORDER BY line_count DESC, o.ord_id ASC
SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(*) AS disc_count FROM prod_catalog WHERE disc_flag = 1 GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY disc_count DESC, categ_cd ASC

SELECT MONTH(o.ord_dt) AS ord_month, SUM(o.ord_total_amt * f.rate_to_usd) AS total_usd_revenue FROM ord_hdr o JOIN fx_rate f ON o.currency_cd = f.currency_cd AND o.ord_dt = f.eff_dt WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY MONTH(o.ord_dt) ORDER BY ord_month ASC

SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id JOIN fx_rate f ON o.currency_cd = f.currency_cd AND o.ord_dt = f.eff_dt WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm HAVING SUM(o.ord_total_amt * f.rate_to_usd) > 1000 ORDER BY SUM(o.ord_total_amt * f.rate_to_usd) DESC, c.cust_id ASC
SELECT ord_status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-06-30' GROUP BY ord_status ORDER BY order_count DESC
SELECT region_cd, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM cust_master WHERE signup_dt >= '2022-01-01' AND signup_dt <= '2022-12-31' GROUP BY region_cd ORDER BY region_cd ASC
SELECT currency_cd, MAX(ord_total_amt) AS max_ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-10-31' GROUP BY currency_cd ORDER BY max_ord_total_amt DESC;

SELECT p.categ_cd, SUM(CASE WHEN w.evt_type = 'VIEW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_views, SUM(CASE WHEN w.evt_type = 'PURCHASE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_purchases, (SUM(CASE WHEN w.evt_type = 'PURCHASE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN w.evt_type = 'VIEW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS purchase_to_view_pct FROM web_event w JOIN prod_catalog p ON w.sku = p.sku WHERE w.evt_ts >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AND w.evt_ts <= '2026-10-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY p.categ_cd ORDER BY purchase_to_view_pct DESC;

SELECT o.channel_cd, COUNT(o.ord_id) AS order_count, AVG(o.ord_total_amt * fx.rate_to_usd) AS avg_usd_amount FROM ord_hdr o JOIN fx_rate fx ON o.currency_cd = fx.currency_cd AND o.ord_dt = fx.eff_dt WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-10-31' GROUP BY o.channel_cd ORDER BY avg_usd_amount DESC;
SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id JOIN support_tkt t ON c.cust_id = t.cust_id ORDER BY c.cust_id ASC;

SELECT c.tier_cd, AVG(p.list_prc) AS avg_list_prc FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id JOIN ord_line l ON o.ord_id = l.ord_id JOIN prod_catalog p ON l.sku = p.sku WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-10-31' GROUP BY c.tier_cd ORDER BY avg_list_prc DESC;
SELECT ord_id, cust_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE currency_cd = 'USD' AND ord_total_amt > 500 ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id ASC;
SELECT cust_id, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_ord_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-10-31' GROUP BY cust_id ORDER BY total_ord_amt DESC, cust_id ASC;

SELECT assigned_emp_id AS emp_id, COUNT(tkt_id) AS tkt_count FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND assigned_emp_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY assigned_emp_id ORDER BY tkt_count DESC, emp_id ASC;
SELECT tier_cd, COUNT(cust_id) AS cust_count FROM cust_master WHERE signup_dt >= '2022-01-01' AND signup_dt <= '2022-12-31' GROUP BY tier_cd ORDER BY tier_cd ASC;
SELECT reason_cd, SUM(rfd_amt) AS total_rfd_amt FROM refund_req WHERE req_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND req_dt <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY reason_cd ORDER BY total_rfd_amt DESC;
SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(tkt_id) AS tkt_count FROM support_tkt WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY categ_cd ASC;
SELECT ord_status, AVG(ord_total_amt) AS avg_ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'APP' AND ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-10-31' GROUP BY ord_status ORDER BY ord_status ASC;
SELECT dept_cd, COUNT(emp_id) AS emp_count FROM emp WHERE hire_dt < '2021-01-01' GROUP BY dept_cd ORDER BY emp_count DESC;
SELECT status_cd, COUNT(rfd_id) AS rfd_count FROM refund_req WHERE rfd_amt > 100 GROUP BY status_cd ORDER BY status_cd ASC;
SELECT cust_id, COUNT(ord_id) AS ord_count FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY cust_id HAVING COUNT(ord_id) > 3 ORDER BY ord_count DESC, cust_id ASC;

SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm, SUM(r.rfd_amt) AS total_approved_amt FROM emp e JOIN refund_req r ON e.emp_id = r.approver_emp_id WHERE r.status_cd = 'A' AND r.decided_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND r.decided_dt <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY e.emp_id, e.emp_nm ORDER BY total_approved_amt DESC;

SELECT c.cust_id, SUM(o.ord_total_amt) AS total_ord_amt FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE c.region_cd = 'NA' AND c.is_actv = 1 AND o.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-10-31' GROUP BY c.cust_id ORDER BY total_ord_amt DESC;

SELECT sev_lvl, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, opened_ts, closed_ts)) AS avg_res_hours FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' AND closed_ts IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sev_lvl ORDER BY sev_lvl ASC;
SELECT actor_emp_id AS emp_id, COUNT(evt_id) AS evt_count FROM tkt_event WHERE evt_type = 'REPLY' AND actor_emp_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY actor_emp_id ORDER BY evt_count DESC;
SELECT cust_id, MAX(ord_total_amt) AS max_ord_amt FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY cust_id HAVING MAX(ord_total_amt) > 500 ORDER BY max_ord_amt DESC;
SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(tkt_id) AS tkt_count FROM support_tkt WHERE categ_cd = 'TECH' GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY tkt_count DESC;
SELECT assigned_emp_id, COUNT(tkt_id) AS tkt_count FROM support_tkt WHERE categ_cd = 'REFD' GROUP BY assigned_emp_id ORDER BY assigned_emp_id ASC;

SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o1 ON c.cust_id = o1.cust_id AND o1.ord_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND o1.ord_dt <= '2025-12-31' JOIN ord_hdr o2 ON c.cust_id = o2.cust_id AND o2.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND o2.ord_dt <= '2026-10-31' GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm ORDER BY c.cust_id ASC;

WITH cust_totals AS (SELECT cust_id, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-10-31' GROUP BY cust_id) SELECT cust_id, total_amt FROM cust_totals WHERE total_amt > (SELECT AVG(total_amt) FROM cust_totals) ORDER BY total_amt DESC;

WITH cust_avg AS (
  SELECT c.cust_id, c.tier_cd, AVG(o.ord_total_amt) AS avg_amt, SUM(o.ord_total_amt) AS total_amt
  FROM cust_master c
  JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id
  WHERE YEAR(o.ord_dt) = 2026
  GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.tier_cd
),
tier_avg AS (
  SELECT tier_cd, AVG(avg_amt) AS tier_mean
  FROM cust_avg
  GROUP BY tier_cd
)
SELECT ca.cust_id, ca.tier_cd, ca.total_amt
FROM cust_avg ca
JOIN tier_avg ta ON ca.tier_cd = ta.tier_cd
WHERE ca.avg_amt > ta.tier_mean

WITH cust_refund AS (
  SELECT c.cust_id, SUM(r.rfd_amt) AS total_rfd
  FROM cust_master c
  JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id
  JOIN refund_req r ON o.ord_id = r.ord_id
  GROUP BY c.cust_id
)
SELECT cust_id, total_rfd
FROM cust_refund
ORDER BY total_rfd DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH emp_tkt AS (
  SELECT e.emp_id, e.dept_cd, COUNT(t.tkt_id) AS tkt_count
  FROM emp e
  LEFT JOIN support_tkt t ON e.emp_id = t.assigned_emp_id
  GROUP BY e.emp_id, e.dept_cd
),
avg_tkt AS (
  SELECT AVG(tkt_count) AS mean_tkt
  FROM emp_tkt
  WHERE dept_cd = 'DEPT'
)
SELECT et.emp_id, et.dept_cd, et.tkt_count
FROM emp_tkt et, avg_tkt at
WHERE et.dept_cd = 'DEPT' AND et.tkt_count > at.mean_tkt

WITH monthly_orders AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS mth, COUNT(ord_id) AS cnt
  FROM ord_hdr
  WHERE YEAR(ord_dt) = 2026
  GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m')
)
SELECT mth, cnt - LAG(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY mth) AS diff
FROM monthly_orders
ORDER BY mth ASC

WITH first_orders AS (
  SELECT cust_id, MIN(ord_dt) AS first_dt
  FROM ord_hdr
  WHERE YEAR(ord_dt) = 2026
  GROUP BY cust_id
)
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(first_dt, '%Y-%m') AS mth, COUNT(cust_id) AS cust_count
FROM first_orders
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(first_dt, '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY mth ASC

WITH app_counts AS (
  SELECT e.dept_cd, r.approver_emp_id AS emp_id, COUNT(*) AS app_cnt,
         DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY e.dept_cd ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) as rnk
  FROM refund_req r
  JOIN emp e ON r.approver_emp_id = e.emp_id
  WHERE YEAR(r.decided_dt) = 2025 AND r.status_cd = 'A'
  GROUP BY e.dept_cd, r.approver_emp_id
)
SELECT dept_cd, emp_id, app_cnt
FROM app_counts
WHERE rnk = 1
ORDER BY dept_cd ASC

SELECT w.wh_id, w.wh_nm, SUM(i.on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand
FROM warehouse w
JOIN inventory i ON w.wh_id = i.wh_id
GROUP BY w.wh_id, w.wh_nm

SELECT method_cd, SUM(pay_amt) AS total_amount, COUNT(*) AS success_count
FROM payment
WHERE pay_status = 'S'
GROUP BY method_cd

SELECT wh_id, SUM(ABS(qty)) AS total_abs_qty
FROM inv_move
WHERE mv_type = 'OUT'
GROUP BY wh_id

SELECT channel_cd, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_order_amount
FROM ord_hdr
WHERE ord_status = 'D'
GROUP BY channel_cd

SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc
FROM prod_catalog
WHERE disc_flag = 0 AND list_prc > 80

SELECT carrier_cd, AVG(DATEDIFF(deliv_dt, ship_dt)) AS avg_lead_time
FROM shipment
WHERE ship_status = 'D' AND deliv_dt IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY carrier_cd

SELECT currency_cd, SUM(pay_amt) AS total_payment_amount
FROM payment
WHERE pay_status = 'S' AND paid_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND paid_ts < '2025-12-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY currency_cd

SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm
FROM prod_catalog p
JOIN ord_line l ON p.sku = l.sku
GROUP BY p.sku, p.prod_nm
ORDER BY SUM(l.qty) DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT w.wh_id, w.wh_nm, COUNT(i.sku) AS low_stock_count
FROM warehouse w
JOIN inventory i ON w.wh_id = i.wh_id
WHERE i.on_hand_qty <= i.reorder_pt
GROUP BY w.wh_id, w.wh_nm

SELECT channel_cd, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_amount, AVG(ord_total_amt) AS avg_amount
FROM ord_hdr
WHERE YEAR(ord_dt) = 2026
GROUP BY channel_cd

SELECT c.cust_id, SUM(o.ord_total_amt) AS total_revenue
FROM cust_master c
JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id
GROUP BY c.cust_id
HAVING COUNT(o.ord_id) > 1

SELECT mv_type, SUM(ABS(qty)) AS total_absolute_qty, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM inv_move
GROUP BY mv_type

SELECT w.wh_id, SUM(i.on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand
FROM warehouse w
JOIN inventory i ON w.wh_id = i.wh_id
GROUP BY w.wh_id
HAVING SUM(i.on_hand_qty) > 2000

WITH prod_qty AS (
  SELECT sku, SUM(qty) AS tot_qty
  FROM ord_line
  GROUP BY sku
)
SELECT sku, tot_qty
FROM prod_qty
WHERE tot_qty > (SELECT AVG(tot_qty) FROM prod_qty)

SELECT wh_id, COUNT(*) AS total_items, SUM(CASE WHEN on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_stock_items, (SUM(CASE WHEN on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS low_stock_percentage
FROM inventory
GROUP BY wh_id

SELECT cust_id
FROM ord_hdr
WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB'
INTERSECT
SELECT cust_id
FROM ord_hdr
WHERE channel_cd = 'APP'

SELECT carrier_cd, COUNT(*) AS total_shipments, SUM(CASE WHEN deliv_dt <= '2026-04-02' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS early_on_time_shipments
FROM shipment
GROUP BY carrier_cd

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN channel_cd = 'WEB' THEN ord_total_amt ELSE 0 END) AS web_revenue,
       SUM(CASE WHEN channel_cd = 'APP' THEN ord_total_amt ELSE 0 END) AS app_revenue,
       SUM(CASE WHEN channel_cd = 'WEB' THEN ord_total_amt ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN channel_cd = 'APP' THEN ord_total_amt ELSE 0 END), 0) AS web_to_app_ratio
FROM ord_hdr
WHERE channel_cd IN ('WEB', 'APP')

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt = '2026-01-08') AS total_orders, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.ord_id) FROM ord_hdr o JOIN payment p ON o.ord_id = p.ord_id WHERE o.ord_dt = '2026-01-08') AS orders_with_payment, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.ord_id) FROM ord_hdr o JOIN shipment s ON o.ord_id = s.ord_id WHERE o.ord_dt = '2026-01-08') AS orders_shipped

WITH settled_payments AS (SELECT method_cd, SUM(pay_amt) AS method_amt FROM payment WHERE currency_cd = 'USD' AND pay_status = 'S' GROUP BY method_cd), total_settled AS (SELECT SUM(pay_amt) AS total_amt FROM payment WHERE currency_cd = 'USD' AND pay_status = 'S') SELECT sp.method_cd, sp.method_amt, ts.total_amt, (sp.method_amt / ts.total_amt) * 100 AS percentage_share FROM settled_payments sp CROSS JOIN total_settled ts ORDER BY sp.method_amt DESC

SELECT p.promo_cd, COUNT(op.ord_id) AS order_count FROM promo p JOIN ord_promo op ON p.promo_id = op.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr o ON op.ord_id = o.ord_id WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY p.promo_id, p.promo_cd ORDER BY order_count DESC, p.promo_cd ASC

SELECT p.promo_cd, AVG(o.ord_total_amt) AS avg_ord_amt FROM promo p JOIN ord_promo op ON p.promo_id = op.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr o ON op.ord_id = o.ord_id GROUP BY p.promo_id, p.promo_cd HAVING AVG(o.ord_total_amt) > 200 ORDER BY avg_ord_amt DESC

SELECT p.promo_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT o.cust_id) AS customer_count FROM promo p JOIN ord_promo op ON p.promo_id = op.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr o ON op.ord_id = o.ord_id GROUP BY p.promo_id, p.promo_cd ORDER BY customer_count DESC
SELECT p.promo_nm FROM promo p LEFT JOIN ord_promo op ON p.promo_id = op.promo_id WHERE op.ord_id IS NULL ORDER BY p.promo_nm ASC
SELECT evt_type, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM web_event WHERE channel_cd = 'APP' AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts < '2025-12-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY evt_type ORDER BY event_count DESC

SELECT sku, COUNT(*) AS view_count FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'VIEW' AND sku IS NOT NULL AND evt_ts >= '2025-12-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts < '2026-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY sku ORDER BY view_count DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT ord_id) AS purchase_count FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'CART') GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY purchase_count DESC
SELECT segment_cd, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE month_dt = '2026-07-01' GROUP BY segment_cd ORDER BY record_count DESC
SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN cust_segment_hist s ON c.cust_id = s.cust_id WHERE s.month_dt = '2026-10-01' AND s.segment_cd = 'VIP' ORDER BY c.cust_nm ASC
SELECT segment_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) AS customer_count FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE month_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND month_dt < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY segment_cd ORDER BY customer_count DESC

SELECT c.tier_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT c.cust_id) AS customer_count FROM cust_master c JOIN cust_segment_hist s ON c.cust_id = s.cust_id WHERE s.month_dt = '2026-09-01' AND s.segment_cd = 'VIP' GROUP BY c.tier_cd ORDER BY customer_count DESC
SELECT region_cd, COUNT(*) AS active_customer_count FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 GROUP BY region_cd ORDER BY active_customer_count DESC

SELECT c.tier_cd, AVG(o.ord_total_amt) AS avg_ord_amt FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND o.ord_dt < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY c.tier_cd ORDER BY avg_ord_amt DESC
SELECT p.promo_cd, COUNT(op.ord_id) AS order_count FROM promo p LEFT JOIN ord_promo op ON p.promo_id = op.promo_id WHERE p.disc_pct > 15.00 GROUP BY p.promo_id, p.promo_cd ORDER BY p.promo_cd ASC
SELECT promo_nm, disc_pct FROM promo WHERE starts_dt <= '2026-04-01' AND ends_dt >= '2026-04-01' ORDER BY disc_pct DESC
SELECT session_id, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM web_event WHERE evt_ts >= '2025-11-09 00:00:00' AND evt_ts < '2025-11-10 00:00:00' GROUP BY session_id ORDER BY event_count DESC

SELECT cust_id, COUNT(*) AS total_events FROM web_event WHERE cust_id IS NOT NULL AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts < '2025-12-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY cust_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 2 ORDER BY total_events DESC

SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) AS customer_count FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND channel_cd = 'WEB' AND cust_id IS NOT NULL AND evt_ts >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts < '2026-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY customer_count DESC
SELECT month_dt, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE segment_cd = 'RISK' GROUP BY month_dt ORDER BY month_dt ASC

SELECT p.promo_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT op.ord_id) AS order_count FROM promo p LEFT JOIN ord_promo op ON p.promo_id = op.promo_id WHERE p.starts_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND p.starts_dt < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY p.promo_id, p.promo_nm ORDER BY order_count DESC

SELECT o.channel_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT o.ord_id) AS order_count FROM ord_hdr o JOIN ord_promo op ON o.ord_id = op.ord_id WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND o.ord_dt < '2026-04-01' GROUP BY o.channel_cd ORDER BY order_count DESC
SELECT tier_cd, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM cust_master GROUP BY tier_cd ORDER BY customer_count DESC
SELECT t1.sku, t2.prod_nm, t1.on_hand_qty FROM inventory AS t1 JOIN prod_catalog AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku JOIN warehouse AS t3 ON t1.wh_id = t3.wh_id WHERE t3.wh_nm = 'Newark Hub'
SELECT t1.sup_nm, t2.lead_days FROM supplier AS t1 JOIN prod_supplier AS t2 ON t1.sup_id = t2.sup_id WHERE t2.sku = 'ELC-024' ORDER BY t2.lead_days DESC, t1.sup_nm ASC
SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND disc_flag = 0
SELECT t1.wh_nm, COUNT(t2.sku) FROM warehouse AS t1 LEFT JOIN inventory AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id WHERE t1.region_cd = 'NA' GROUP BY t1.wh_id, t1.wh_nm
SELECT t1.sku, t2.prod_nm, t1.on_hand_qty FROM inventory AS t1 JOIN prod_catalog AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t1.on_hand_qty <= t1.reorder_pt ORDER BY t1.sku
SELECT t1.mv_type, SUM(t1.qty) FROM inv_move AS t1 JOIN warehouse AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id WHERE t2.wh_nm = 'Rotterdam Hub' GROUP BY t1.mv_type
SELECT t1.sku, t1.prod_nm, t1.list_prc FROM prod_catalog AS t1 JOIN prod_supplier AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku JOIN supplier AS t3 ON t2.sup_id = t3.sup_id WHERE t3.sup_nm = 'Orion Electronics'
SELECT sku, SUM(ABS(qty)) AS total_abs_qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'ADJ' GROUP BY sku ORDER BY total_abs_qty DESC, sku ASC
SELECT t1.wh_nm, SUM(t2.on_hand_qty) FROM warehouse AS t1 JOIN inventory AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id JOIN prod_catalog AS t3 ON t2.sku = t3.sku WHERE t3.categ_cd = 'KIT' GROUP BY t1.wh_id, t1.wh_nm
SELECT t1.sup_nm, COUNT(t2.sku) AS product_count FROM supplier AS t1 JOIN prod_supplier AS t2 ON t1.sup_id = t2.sup_id GROUP BY t1.sup_id, t1.sup_nm ORDER BY product_count DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT t1.wh_nm, COUNT(t2.mv_id) FROM warehouse AS t1 JOIN inv_move AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id WHERE t2.mv_type = 'IN' AND t2.mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND t2.mv_ts <= '2025-10-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY t1.wh_id, t1.wh_nm

SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm, p.categ_cd, p.list_prc FROM prod_catalog AS p JOIN (SELECT categ_cd, AVG(list_prc) AS avg_prc FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd) AS c ON p.categ_cd = c.categ_cd WHERE p.list_prc > c.avg_prc

SELECT t1.wh_nm, (SUM(CASE WHEN t2.on_hand_qty <= t2.reorder_pt THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(t2.sku)) AS low_stock_pct FROM warehouse AS t1 JOIN inventory AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id GROUP BY t1.wh_id, t1.wh_nm ORDER BY low_stock_pct DESC
SELECT t1.wh_nm, SUM(t2.on_hand_qty) AS total_units FROM warehouse AS t1 JOIN inventory AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id GROUP BY t1.wh_id, t1.wh_nm ORDER BY total_units DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog AS p JOIN prod_supplier AS ps1 ON p.sku = ps1.sku JOIN supplier AS s1 ON ps1.sup_id = s1.sup_id AND s1.sup_nm = 'Orion Electronics' JOIN prod_supplier AS ps2 ON p.sku = ps2.sku JOIN supplier AS s2 ON ps2.sup_id = s2.sup_id AND s2.sup_nm = 'Pacific Metalworks'
SELECT categ_cd, sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM (SELECT categ_cd, sku, prod_nm, list_prc, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY categ_cd ORDER BY list_prc DESC) as rnk FROM prod_catalog) t WHERE rnk = 1
SELECT t1.sup_nm, AVG(t2.lead_days) AS avg_lead FROM supplier AS t1 JOIN prod_supplier AS t2 ON t1.sup_id = t2.sup_id GROUP BY t1.sup_id, t1.sup_nm HAVING avg_lead > 25 ORDER BY avg_lead DESC
SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog AS p JOIN ord_line AS o ON p.sku = o.sku GROUP BY p.sku, p.prod_nm HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.ord_id) >= 2
SELECT sku, SUM(qty) AS total_qty FROM ord_line GROUP BY sku ORDER BY total_qty DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT t1.wh_nm, SUM(t2.on_hand_qty) AS total_units FROM warehouse AS t1 JOIN inventory AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id JOIN prod_catalog AS t3 ON t2.sku = t3.sku WHERE t3.categ_cd = 'ELC' GROUP BY t1.wh_id, t1.wh_nm ORDER BY total_units DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT t1.sup_nm, COUNT(t2.sku) AS primary_count FROM supplier AS t1 JOIN prod_supplier AS t2 ON t1.sup_id = t2.sup_id WHERE t2.is_primary = 1 GROUP BY t1.sup_id, t1.sup_nm ORDER BY primary_count DESC
SELECT t1.sku, t2.prod_nm, MAX(t1.unit_prc) AS max_line_prc FROM ord_line AS t1 JOIN prod_catalog AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku GROUP BY t1.sku, t2.prod_nm HAVING max_line_prc > 200.00
SELECT DISTINCT ord_id, ord_dt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND currency_cd = 'USD' AND ord_total_amt > 500
SELECT sku, unit_prc FROM ord_line WHERE ord_id = 'O-5001' AND qty >= 2 ORDER BY unit_prc DESC
-- UNANSWERABLE: The code_lookup table does not contain a department code for finance.
SELECT sku, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'HOM' AND list_prc > (SELECT AVG(list_prc) FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'HOM')

SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_h_alias h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id JOIN fx_rate f ON h.currency_cd = f.currency_cd AND h.ord_dt = f.eff_dt WHERE h.ord_dt >= '2026-07-01' AND h.ord_dt <= '2026-07-31' AND (h.ord_total_amt * f.rate_to_usd) > 800

SELECT h.ord_id, h.ord_total_amt, COUNT(l.line_no) AS line_count FROM ord_hdr h JOIN ord_line l ON h.ord_id = l.ord_id WHERE h.ord_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND h.ord_dt <= '2026-04-30' GROUP BY h.ord_id, h.ord_total_amt
SELECT p.prod_nm, SUM(l.qty) AS total_qty FROM prod_catalog p JOIN ord_line l ON p.sku = l.sku WHERE p.categ_cd = 'KIT' GROUP BY p.sku, p.prod_nm
SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id WHERE c.tier_cd = 'G' AND h.channel_cd = 'APP'
SELECT DISTINCT sku FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'OUT' AND qty < -3
SELECT currency_cd, MAX(ord_total_amt) AS max_total FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY currency_cd
SELECT DISTINCT l.sku FROM ord_line l WHERE l.qty > 3 AND l.ord_id NOT IN (SELECT ord_id FROM refund_req)

SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c WHERE c.cust_id IN (SELECT cust_id FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-04-30') AND c.cust_id IN (SELECT cust_id FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-06-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-06-30')
SELECT DISTINCT p.sku FROM prod_catalog p JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE p.list_prc > 100 AND i.on_hand_qty < i.reorder_pt

SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id WHERE c.signup_dt >= '2022-01-01' AND c.signup_dt <= '2022-12-31' AND h.channel_cd = 'STR' AND c.cust_id NOT IN (SELECT cust_id FROM support_tkt WHERE categ_cd = 'BILL')

SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN web_event w ON c.cust_id = w.cust_id WHERE c.is_actv = 1 AND c.region_cd = 'AP' AND w.evt_type = 'PURCHASE'

SELECT DISTINCT p.sku, p.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog p JOIN ord_line l ON p.sku = l.sku WHERE l.disc_pct > 10

SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id WHERE h.channel_cd = 'WEB' AND c.cust_id NOT IN (SELECT cust_id FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'APP') ORDER BY c.cust_id
SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id WHERE h.currency_cd IN ('EUR', 'GBP') ORDER BY c.cust_id

SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE list_prc > 30.00 AND disc_flag = 0 ORDER BY sku;
SELECT wh_id, wh_nm FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd IN ('NA', 'EU') ORDER BY wh_id;
SELECT rfd_id, ord_id, rfd_amt FROM refund_req WHERE status_cd = 'A' AND approver_emp_id = 'E-003' ORDER BY rfd_id;
SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM emp WHERE dept_cd = 'FIN' AND hire_dt BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' ORDER BY hire_dt, emp_id;

SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE o.channel_cd = 'STR' AND c.region_cd = 'AP' AND c.tier_cd = 'P' GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm ORDER BY c.cust_id;
SELECT promo_id, promo_nm, disc_pct FROM promo WHERE starts_dt >= '2025-11-01' ORDER BY promo_id;
SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE currency_cd = 'USD' AND channel_cd = 'WEB' AND ord_dt = '2026-04-03' ORDER BY ord_id;
SELECT tkt_id, cust_id FROM support_tkt WHERE sev_lvl = 1 AND channel_cd = 'APP' ORDER BY tkt_id;

SELECT ship_id, ord_id, carrier_cd FROM shipment WHERE carrier_cd = 'UPS' AND deliv_dt >= '2025-11-01' ORDER BY ship_id;
SELECT pay_id, ord_id, pay_amt FROM payment WHERE method_cd = 'CC' AND pay_status = 'S' AND pay_amt > 100.00 ORDER BY pay_id;
SELECT rfd_id, rfd_amt FROM refund_req WHERE reason_cd = 'DMG' AND rfd_amt > 50.00 ORDER BY rfd_amt DESC, rfd_id ASC;
SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM emp WHERE emp_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT approver_emp_id FROM refund_req WHERE approver_emp_id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY emp_id;
SELECT sup_id, sup_nm, country FROM supplier WHERE country IN ('US', 'CA') ORDER BY sup_id;
SELECT ship_id, ord_id, wh_id FROM shipment WHERE carrier_cd = 'UPS' AND ship_dt >= '2026-05-01' ORDER BY ship_id;
SELECT pay_id, ord_id, pay_amt FROM payment WHERE method_cd = 'PP' AND pay_amt > 200.00 ORDER BY pay_id;
SELECT sku, mv_id, qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'ADJ' ORDER BY mv_id;
SELECT ship_id, deliv_dt FROM shipment WHERE wh_id = 'W2' AND ship_status = 'D' ORDER BY deliv_dt ASC, ship_id DESC;

SELECT ord_id, pay_amt FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' ORDER BY pay_amt DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT channel_cd, AVG(ord_total_amt) AS avg_amt FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY channel_cd;

SELECT sku FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W1' AND sku IN (SELECT sku FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W2') ORDER BY sku;
SELECT sku, wh_id FROM inventory WHERE wh_id IN ('W3', 'W4') ORDER BY sku, wh_id;
