SELECT wh_id, SUM(ABS(qty)) AS total_abs_qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type IN ('OUT', 'IN') GROUP BY wh_id;
SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN cust_segment_hist s ON c.cust_id = s.cust_id WHERE c.region_cd = 'NA' AND s.month_dt = '2026-10-01' AND s.segment_cd = 'VIP';
SELECT DISTINCT p.promo_id, p.promo_nm FROM promo p JOIN ord_promo op ON p.promo_id = op.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr o ON op.ord_id = o.ord_id WHERE o.channel_cd = 'STR';
SELECT promo_cd, promo_nm FROM promo WHERE starts_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND disc_pct > 15;

SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c WHERE c.cust_id IN (SELECT cust_id FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'CART' AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01' AND evt_ts < '2025-12-01') AND c.cust_id IN (SELECT cust_id FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01' AND evt_ts < '2025-12-01');
SELECT channel_cd, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_order_amount FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY channel_cd;
SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE region_cd = 'AP' AND is_actv = 1 AND signup_dt >= '2022-01-01' AND signup_dt <= '2022-12-31';
SELECT DISTINCT p.promo_cd FROM promo p JOIN ord_promo op ON p.promo_id = op.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr o ON op.ord_id = o.ord_id WHERE o.ord_dt IN ('2026-04-03', '2026-04-04');

SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c WHERE c.cust_id IN (SELECT cust_id FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE month_dt = '2026-06-01' AND segment_cd = 'VIP') AND c.cust_id IN (SELECT cust_id FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE month_dt = '2026-07-01' AND segment_cd = 'VIP');
SELECT tier_cd, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM cust_master WHERE region_cd = 'EU' AND is_actv = 1 GROUP BY tier_cd;
SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id JOIN support_tkt t ON c.cust_id = t.cust_id WHERE o.channel_cd = 'PHN' AND t.sev_lvl = 1;
SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE cust_id IN (SELECT cust_id FROM ord_hdr WHERE currency_cd = 'USD') AND cust_id NOT IN (SELECT cust_id FROM ord_hdr WHERE currency_cd = 'EUR');
SELECT segment_cd, COUNT(*) AS count FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE month_dt = '2026-09-01' GROUP BY segment_cd;

SELECT DISTINCT p.promo_cd FROM promo p JOIN ord_promo op ON p.promo_id = op.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr o ON op.ord_id = o.ord_id WHERE o.channel_cd = 'APP' UNION SELECT DISTINCT p.promo_cd FROM promo p JOIN ord_promo op ON p.promo_id = op.promo_id JOIN web_event w ON op.ord_id = w.ord_id WHERE w.channel_cd = 'APP';

SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c WHERE c.cust_id IN (SELECT cust_id FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE month_dt = '2026-07-01' AND segment_cd = 'REG') AND c.cust_id NOT IN (SELECT cust_id FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE segment_cd = 'VIP');

SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN web_event w ON c.cust_id = w.cust_id WHERE w.session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'VIEW') AND w.session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'PURCHASE');
SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM web_event WHERE channel_cd IN ('APP', 'WEB') AND cust_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY channel_cd;
SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE cust_nm LIKE 'Elena%';

SELECT DISTINCT t1.promo_id FROM ord_promo t1 JOIN ord_hdr t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id JOIN cust_master t3 ON t2.cust_id = t3.cust_id WHERE t3.region_cd = 'NA' AND t1.promo_id IN (SELECT t4.promo_id FROM ord_promo t4 JOIN ord_hdr t5 ON t4.ord_id = t5.ord_id JOIN cust_master t6 ON t5.cust_id = t6.cust_id WHERE t6.region_cd = 'EU')
SELECT promo_cd, disc_pct FROM promo WHERE starts_dt < '2026-02-01' AND ends_dt > '2026-02-01'
SELECT t1.sku, t1.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog t1 JOIN prod_supplier t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t2.sup_id = 1 AND t1.sku IN (SELECT sku FROM prod_supplier WHERE sup_id = 6) ORDER BY t1.prod_nm

SELECT t1.wh_id, t1.wh_nm FROM warehouse t1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prod_catalog t2 WHERE t2.categ_cd = 'HOM' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inventory t3 WHERE t3.wh_id = t1.wh_id AND t3.sku = t2.sku)) ORDER BY t1.wh_id

SELECT DISTINCT t1.sku, t2.prod_nm FROM inv_move t1 JOIN prod_catalog t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t1.mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND t1.mv_type = 'OUT' AND t1.sku IN (SELECT sku FROM inv_move WHERE mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND mv_type = 'IN') ORDER BY t1.sku

SELECT t1.sup_id, t1.sup_nm FROM supplier t1 JOIN prod_supplier t2 ON t1.sup_id = t2.sup_id JOIN prod_catalog t3 ON t2.sku = t3.sku WHERE t3.categ_cd = 'KIT' AND t1.sup_id IN (SELECT t4.sup_id FROM supplier t4 JOIN prod_supplier t5 ON t4.sup_id = t5.sup_id JOIN prod_catalog t6 ON t5.sku = t6.sku WHERE t6.categ_cd = 'ELC') ORDER BY t1.sup_id
SELECT DISTINCT t1.wh_id, t1.wh_nm FROM warehouse t1 JOIN inv_move t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id WHERE t2.sku IN ('ELC-026', 'ELC-027') ORDER BY t1.wh_id
SELECT DISTINCT t1.sku, t2.prod_nm FROM ord_line t1 JOIN prod_catalog t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t1.qty > 3 ORDER BY t1.sku
SELECT DISTINCT t1.sku, t1.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog t1 JOIN inventory t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t1.disc_flag = 1 AND t2.on_hand_qty > 0 ORDER BY t1.sku
SELECT t1.sku, t1.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog t1 JOIN prod_supplier t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t1.list_prc > 50.00 AND t2.sup_id = 5 ORDER BY t1.list_prc DESC, t1.sku
SELECT t1.wh_id, t1.wh_nm, SUM(t2.on_hand_qty) AS total_qty FROM warehouse t1 JOIN inventory t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id GROUP BY t1.wh_id, t1.wh_nm ORDER BY total_qty DESC

SELECT t1.sup_id, t1.sup_nm, COUNT(t2.sku) AS product_count FROM supplier t1 JOIN prod_supplier t2 ON t1.sup_id = t2.sup_id WHERE t2.is_primary = 1 GROUP BY t1.sup_id, t1.sup_nm ORDER BY product_count DESC, t1.sup_id
SELECT region_cd, COUNT(*) AS wh_count FROM warehouse GROUP BY region_cd ORDER BY wh_count DESC, region_cd
SELECT t1.sku, t1.prod_nm, MAX(t2.lead_days) AS max_lead_days FROM prod_catalog t1 JOIN prod_supplier t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku GROUP BY t1.sku, t1.prod_nm ORDER BY t1.sku
SELECT t1.wh_id, t1.wh_nm, AVG(t2.reorder_pt) AS avg_reorder_pt FROM warehouse t1 JOIN inventory t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id GROUP BY t1.wh_id, t1.wh_nm ORDER BY t1.wh_id
SELECT t1.sku, t2.prod_nm FROM inventory t1 JOIN prod_catalog t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t1.wh_id = 'W1' AND t1.on_hand_qty < t1.reorder_pt ORDER BY t1.sku

SELECT t1.sup_id, t1.sup_nm FROM supplier t1 JOIN prod_supplier t2 ON t1.sup_id = t2.sup_id JOIN prod_catalog t3 ON t2.sku = t3.sku WHERE t3.categ_cd = 'HOM' AND t1.sup_id IN (SELECT t4.sup_id FROM supplier t4 JOIN prod_supplier t5 ON t4.sup_id = t5.sup_id JOIN prod_catalog t6 ON t5.sku = t6.sku WHERE t6.categ_cd = 'OFC') ORDER BY t1.sup_id
SELECT DISTINCT t1.sku, t2.prod_nm FROM inv_move t1 JOIN prod_catalog t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t1.mv_type = 'ADJ' AND t1.sku NOT IN (SELECT sku FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'OUT') ORDER BY t1.sku
SELECT categ_cd, AVG(list_prc) AS avg_list_prc FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY avg_list_prc DESC
SELECT DISTINCT t1.sku, t1.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog t1 JOIN prod_supplier t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE (t2.sup_id = 1 OR t2.sup_id = 2) AND t1.list_prc > 75.00 ORDER BY t1.sku
SELECT t1.wh_id, t1.wh_nm FROM warehouse t1 JOIN inventory t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id WHERE t2.sku = 'ELC-024' AND t1.wh_id IN (SELECT wh_id FROM inventory WHERE sku = 'ELC-025') ORDER BY t1.wh_id
SELECT t1.sku, t2.prod_nm FROM inventory t1 JOIN prod_catalog t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t1.wh_id = 'W2' AND t1.sku NOT IN (SELECT sku FROM prod_supplier WHERE sup_id = 2) ORDER BY t1.sku

SELECT t1.sup_id, t1.sup_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.categ_cd) AS categ_count FROM supplier t1 JOIN prod_supplier t3 ON t1.sup_id = t3.sup_id JOIN prod_catalog t2 ON t3.sku = t2.sku GROUP BY t1.sup_id, t1.sup_nm ORDER BY categ_count DESC, t1.sup_id

SELECT t1.cust_nm, t2.ord_id, t2.ord_total_amt FROM cust_master t1 JOIN ord_hdr t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE YEAR(t2.ord_dt) = 2026 AND t2.ord_total_amt > (SELECT AVG(t3.ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr t3 WHERE t3.cust_id = t2.cust_id) ORDER BY t1.cust_nm ASC, t2.ord_id ASC
SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog p WHERE p.list_prc > (SELECT AVG(p2.list_prc) FROM prod_catalog p2 WHERE p2.categ_cd = p.categ_cd) ORDER BY p.categ_cd, p.sku;
SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c WHERE c.region_cd = 'EU' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_hdr o WHERE o.cust_id = c.cust_id AND o.channel_cd = 'APP') ORDER BY c.cust_nm;

SELECT o.ord_id, o.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr o JOIN cust_master c ON o.cust_id = c.cust_id WHERE c.tier_cd = 'P' AND o.ord_total_amt = (SELECT MAX(o2.ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr o2 WHERE o2.cust_id = o.cust_id) ORDER BY o.ord_total_amt DESC;
SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND list_prc = (SELECT MAX(list_prc) FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC') ORDER BY sku;

SELECT o.ord_id, o.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr o WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_line l WHERE l.ord_id = o.ord_id AND l.unit_prc <= 100) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_line l WHERE l.ord_id = o.ord_id) ORDER BY o.ord_id;
SELECT sku, unit_prc, disc_pct FROM ord_line WHERE ord_id = 'O-5001' ORDER BY line_no;

SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm, o.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr o JOIN cust_master c ON o.cust_id = c.cust_id WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-07-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-07-31' AND o.ord_total_amt > (SELECT AVG(o2.ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr o2 WHERE o2.ord_dt >= '2026-07-01' AND o2.ord_dt <= '2026-07-31') ORDER BY o.ord_total_amt DESC;
SELECT currency_cd, MAX(rate_to_usd) AS max_rate_to_usd FROM fx_rate GROUP BY currency_cd ORDER BY currency_cd;

SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE c.is_actv = 1 AND c.region_cd = 'NA' GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm HAVING COUNT(o.ord_id) >= 3 ORDER BY c.cust_nm;
SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog p JOIN ord_line l ON p.sku = l.sku WHERE l.qty = (SELECT MAX(l2.qty) FROM ord_line l2 WHERE l2.sku = p.sku) GROUP BY p.sku, p.prod_nm ORDER BY p.sku;
SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE cust_id = 'C-1006' ORDER BY ord_dt DESC, ord_id DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, tier_cd FROM cust_master WHERE cust_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT o.cust_id FROM ord_hdr o WHERE o.ord_status = 'C') ORDER BY cust_id;
SELECT code_val, code_desc FROM code_lookup WHERE code_type = 'REGION' ORDER BY code_val;
SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE region_cd = 'AP' ORDER BY signup_dt ASC, cust_id ASC;
SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE list_prc > (SELECT MAX(list_prc) FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'KIT') ORDER BY list_prc DESC;
SELECT currency_cd, eff_dt, rate_to_usd FROM fx_rate WHERE rate_to_usd = 1.000000 ORDER BY currency_cd;

SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND YEAR(ord_dt) = 2026 AND ord_total_amt > (SELECT AVG(ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND YEAR(ord_dt) = 2026) ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id;
SELECT sku, prod_nm, categ_cd FROM prod_catalog WHERE sku NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT sku FROM ord_line) ORDER BY sku;
SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, region_cd FROM cust_master c WHERE signup_dt = (SELECT MIN(c2.signup_dt) FROM cust_master c2 WHERE c2.region_cd = c.region_cd) ORDER BY region_cd, cust_id;
SELECT ord_id, ord_status, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_status = 'D' ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id;
SELECT tkt_id, opened_ts FROM support_tkt WHERE categ_cd = 'SHIP' AND opened_ts > '2026-04-05 00:00:00';
SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm FROM emp e JOIN code_lookup c ON e.dept_cd = c.code_val WHERE c.code_type = 'DEPT' AND c.code_desc LIKE '%support%' AND e.hire_dt < '2020-01-01';
SELECT rfd_id, rfd_amt FROM refund_req WHERE reason_cd = 'DMG' AND status_cd = 'A';
SELECT DISTINCT rule_key, rule_val FROM policy_rule WHERE eff_from <= '2025-12-31' AND (eff_to >= '2025-01-01' OR eff_to IS NULL);
SELECT tkt_id, cust_id FROM support_tkt WHERE assigned_emp_id = 'E-007' AND closed_ts IS NULL;
SELECT ord_id, ord_dt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_total_amt > 500;
SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE o.channel_cd = 'APP';
SELECT t.tkt_id, COUNT(e.evt_id) AS event_count FROM support_tkt t JOIN tkt_event e ON t.tkt_id = e.tkt_id GROUP BY t.tkt_id HAVING COUNT(e.evt_id) > 2;
SELECT rfd_id, rfd_amt FROM refund_req WHERE approver_emp_id = 'E-003' AND status_cd = 'A';

SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN support_tkt t ON c.cust_id = t.cust_id WHERE t.categ_cd = 'BILL' AND c.cust_id NOT IN (SELECT r.cust_id FROM refund_req r JOIN ord_hdr o ON r.ord_id = o.ord_id);
SELECT DISTINCT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm FROM emp e JOIN refund_req r ON e.emp_id = r.approver_emp_id WHERE r.rfd_amt > 100;
SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(*) AS ticket_count FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts < '2026-05-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY categ_cd;
SELECT o.ord_id, o.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr o JOIN payment p ON o.ord_id = p.ord_id WHERE p.method_cd = 'CC' AND p.pay_status = 'S';

SELECT t.tkt_id, t.cust_id FROM support_tkt t JOIN policy_rule p ON p.rule_key = 'sla_hours_sev1' AND t.opened_ts >= p.eff_from AND (p.eff_to IS NULL OR t.opened_ts <= p.eff_to) WHERE t.sev_lvl = 1 AND t.opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND t.opened_ts < '2026-05-01 00:00:00' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, t.opened_ts, COALESCE(t.closed_ts, '2026-05-01 00:00:00')) > CAST(p.rule_val AS SIGNED);

SELECT r1.rfd_id, r1.reason_cd, r1.rfd_amt FROM refund_req r1 JOIN (SELECT reason_cd, AVG(rfd_amt) AS avg_amt FROM refund_req GROUP BY reason_cd) r2 ON r1.reason_cd = r2.reason_cd WHERE r1.rfd_amt > r2.avg_amt;

SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN (SELECT o1.cust_id, o1.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr o1 WHERE o1.ord_dt = (SELECT MAX(o2.ord_dt) FROM ord_hdr o2 WHERE o2.cust_id = o1.cust_id)) latest ON c.cust_id = latest.cust_id JOIN (SELECT c_sub.region_cd, AVG(o_sub.ord_total_amt) AS avg_region_amt FROM ord_hdr o_sub JOIN cust_master c_sub ON o_sub.cust_id = c_sub.cust_id GROUP BY c_sub.region_cd) reg_avg ON c.region_cd = reg_avg.region_cd WHERE latest.ord_total_amt > reg_avg.avg_region_amt ORDER BY c.cust_id ASC;
SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_total_amt > (SELECT MAX(ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr WHERE cust_id = 'C-1001') ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id ASC;
SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM emp WHERE emp_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT assigned_emp_id FROM support_tkt WHERE assigned_emp_id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY emp_id ASC;
SELECT DISTINCT t.tkt_id, t.cust_id, t.opened_ts FROM support_tkt t JOIN tkt_event e ON t.tkt_id = e.tkt_id WHERE e.evt_type = 'ESCAL' ORDER BY t.opened_ts ASC;

SELECT r.rfd_id, r.req_dt, r.rfd_amt FROM refund_req r JOIN policy_rule p ON p.rule_key = 'refund_approval_threshold' AND r.req_dt >= p.eff_from AND (p.eff_to IS NULL OR r.req_dt <= p.eff_to) WHERE r.rfd_amt > CAST(p.rule_val AS DECIMAL(10,2));
SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.channel_cd) > 1 ORDER BY c.cust_id ASC;
SELECT w.wh_id, w.wh_nm, i.sku FROM warehouse w JOIN inventory i ON w.wh_id = i.wh_id WHERE w.region_cd = 'NA' AND i.on_hand_qty < i.reorder_pt ORDER BY w.wh_id ASC, i.sku ASC;
SELECT ship_id, ord_id, deliv_dt FROM shipment WHERE carrier_cd = 'DHL' AND deliv_dt > '2026-04-01' ORDER BY deliv_dt DESC, ship_id ASC;
SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE sku NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT sku FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'OUT') ORDER BY prod_nm ASC;
SELECT method_cd, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, SUM(pay_amt) AS total_amount FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' AND currency_cd = 'USD' GROUP BY method_cd ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT w.wh_id, w.wh_nm, MAX(p.pay_amt) AS max_payment_amount FROM warehouse w JOIN shipment s ON w.wh_id = s.wh_id JOIN payment p ON s.ord_id = p.ord_id GROUP BY w.wh_id, w.wh_nm ORDER BY max_payment_amount DESC;

SELECT i.sku, i.on_hand_qty FROM inventory i JOIN (SELECT sku, AVG(on_hand_qty) AS avg_qty FROM inventory GROUP BY sku) avg_inv ON i.sku = avg_inv.sku WHERE i.wh_id = 'W1' AND i.on_hand_qty > avg_inv.avg_qty ORDER BY i.sku ASC;
SELECT i.sku, i.wh_id, i.on_hand_qty FROM inventory i JOIN prod_catalog p ON i.sku = p.sku WHERE p.categ_cd = 'ELC' AND i.on_hand_qty > 300 ORDER BY i.on_hand_qty DESC, i.sku ASC;
SELECT carrier_cd, MAX(ship_dt) AS max_ship_dt FROM shipment GROUP BY carrier_cd ORDER BY carrier_cd ASC;
SELECT pay_id, ord_id, pay_amt FROM payment WHERE method_cd = 'CC' AND pay_amt > 200 ORDER BY pay_amt DESC;

SELECT p1.sku, p1.prod_nm, p1.categ_cd, p1.list_prc FROM prod_catalog p1 WHERE p1.list_prc > (SELECT AVG(p2.list_prc) FROM prod_catalog p2 WHERE p2.categ_cd = p1.categ_cd) ORDER BY p1.categ_cd ASC, p1.list_prc DESC;
SELECT w.wh_id, w.wh_nm, COUNT(s.ship_id) AS shipment_count FROM warehouse w JOIN shipment s ON w.wh_id = s.wh_id WHERE s.carrier_cd = 'UPS' GROUP BY w.wh_id, w.wh_nm ORDER BY shipment_count DESC;
SELECT ord_id, COUNT(*) AS payment_count FROM payment GROUP BY ord_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY payment_count DESC, ord_id ASC;
SELECT DISTINCT w.wh_nm, w.region_cd FROM warehouse w JOIN inventory i ON w.wh_id = i.wh_id WHERE i.on_hand_qty > 900 ORDER BY w.wh_nm ASC;
SELECT sku, MIN(qty) AS min_qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'OUT' GROUP BY sku ORDER BY sku ASC;

SELECT o.ord_id, o.ord_dt, s.ship_dt FROM ord_hdr o JOIN shipment s ON o.ord_id = s.ord_id JOIN warehouse w ON s.wh_id = w.wh_id WHERE o.channel_cd = 'WEB' AND w.wh_nm = 'Newark Hub' ORDER BY o.ord_dt ASC;
SELECT p.categ_cd, SUM(i.on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand FROM prod_catalog p JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku GROUP BY p.categ_cd ORDER BY total_on_hand DESC;
SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE list_prc > 100 AND disc_flag = 0 ORDER BY list_prc DESC;
SELECT ord_id, MAX(paid_ts) AS max_paid_ts FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' GROUP BY ord_id ORDER BY ord_id ASC;
SELECT carrier_cd, COUNT(*) AS in_transit_count FROM shipment WHERE ship_status = 'I' GROUP BY carrier_cd ORDER BY in_transit_count DESC;

SELECT o1.ord_id, o1.channel_cd, o1.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr o1 WHERE o1.ord_total_amt > (SELECT AVG(o2.ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr o2 WHERE o2.channel_cd = o1.channel_cd) ORDER BY o1.channel_cd ASC, o1.ord_total_amt DESC;
SELECT mv_id, sku, wh_id, qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'ADJ' AND qty > 0 ORDER BY mv_id ASC;
SELECT w.wh_id, w.wh_nm FROM warehouse w JOIN inventory i ON w.wh_id = i.wh_id GROUP BY w.wh_id, w.wh_nm HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT i.sku) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM prod_catalog) ORDER BY w.wh_id ASC;
SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog ORDER BY list_prc DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT promo_cd, promo_nm FROM promo WHERE starts_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND starts_dt <= '2025-12-31';
SELECT session_id, cust_id FROM web_event WHERE evt_ts >= '2025-11-23 00:00:00' AND evt_ts <= '2025-11-23 23:59:59' AND evt_type = 'CART' ORDER BY session_id ASC;
SELECT cust_id, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND region_cd = 'NA' AND signup_dt > '2022-07-31' ORDER BY signup_dt ASC;
SELECT promo_id, COUNT(ord_id) AS ord_count FROM ord_promo GROUP BY promo_id ORDER BY ord_count DESC;
SELECT c.cust_nm, c.tier_cd FROM cust_master c JOIN cust_segment_hist s ON c.cust_id = s.cust_id WHERE s.month_dt = '2026-07-01' AND s.segment_cd = 'VIP' ORDER BY c.cust_nm ASC;
SELECT AVG(ord_total_amt) AS avg_ord_total FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND currency_cd = 'USD' AND ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30';
SELECT promo_nm, disc_pct FROM promo WHERE promo_id NOT IN (SELECT promo_id FROM ord_promo) ORDER BY promo_id ASC;
SELECT cust_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30' ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.promo_cd, p.promo_nm, COUNT(op.ord_id) AS order_cnt FROM promo p JOIN ord_promo op ON p.promo_id = op.promo_id GROUP BY p.promo_id, p.promo_cd, p.promo_nm HAVING COUNT(op.ord_id) > 1 ORDER BY order_cnt DESC
SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN web_event w ON c.cust_id = w.cust_id WHERE w.evt_type = 'VIEW' AND c.cust_id NOT IN (SELECT cust_id FROM ord_hdr)

SELECT o1.ord_id, o1.channel_cd, o1.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr o1 JOIN (SELECT channel_cd, AVG(ord_total_amt) AS avg_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE YEAR(ord_dt) = 2026 GROUP BY channel_cd) avg_tbl ON o1.channel_cd = avg_tbl.channel_cd WHERE YEAR(o1.ord_dt) = 2026 AND o1.ord_total_amt > avg_tbl.avg_amt ORDER BY o1.ord_id

SELECT cur.cust_id, cur.month_dt, cur.segment_cd FROM cust_segment_hist cur JOIN cust_segment_hist prev ON cur.cust_id = prev.cust_id AND prev.month_dt = DATE_SUB(cur.month_dt, INTERVAL 1 MONTH) WHERE cur.segment_cd <> prev.segment_cd ORDER BY cur.cust_id, cur.month_dt

SELECT c.tier_cd, c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN (SELECT tier_cd, MIN(signup_dt) AS min_signup FROM cust_master GROUP BY tier_cd) earliest ON c.tier_cd = earliest.tier_cd AND c.signup_dt = earliest.min_signup ORDER BY c.tier_cd

SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE YEAR(o.ord_dt) = 2026 GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT QUARTER(o.ord_dt)) = 4 ORDER BY c.cust_id

SELECT c.cust_id, SUM(o.ord_total_amt * COALESCE(fx.rate_to_usd, 1)) AS total_spend FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id LEFT JOIN fx_rate fx ON o.currency_cd = fx.currency_cd AND o.ord_dt = fx.eff_dt WHERE c.is_actv = 1 AND c.region_cd = 'EU' GROUP BY c.cust_id HAVING total_spend > 500 ORDER BY total_spend DESC
SELECT promo_nm, starts_dt FROM promo WHERE starts_dt >= (SELECT starts_dt FROM promo WHERE promo_nm = 'Black Friday') ORDER BY starts_dt ASC

SELECT a.cust_id, a.month_dt, a.segment_cd FROM cust_segment_hist a JOIN cust_segment_hist b ON a.cust_id = b.cust_id WHERE a.month_dt = '2026-06-01' AND a.segment_cd = 'REG' AND b.month_dt = '2026-07-01' AND b.segment_cd = 'VIP' ORDER BY a.cust_id
SELECT o.ord_id, o.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr o JOIN ord_promo op ON o.ord_id = op.ord_id GROUP BY o.ord_id, o.ord_total_amt HAVING COUNT(op.promo_id) > 1 ORDER BY o.ord_total_amt DESC
SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE cust_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT cust_id FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND cust_id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY cust_id
SELECT op.promo_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.cust_id) AS customer_cnt FROM ord_promo op JOIN ord_hdr o ON op.ord_id = o.ord_id GROUP BY op.promo_id ORDER BY customer_cnt DESC

SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id JOIN web_event w ON c.cust_id = w.cust_id WHERE DATE_FORMAT(o.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') = '2026-04' AND DATE_FORMAT(w.evt_ts, '%Y-%m') = '2026-04' AND w.evt_type = 'CHECKOUT' ORDER BY c.cust_id

SELECT c.region_cd, SUM(o.ord_total_amt * COALESCE(fx.rate_to_usd, 1)) AS total_amount FROM ord_hdr o JOIN cust_master c ON o.cust_id = c.cust_id LEFT JOIN fx_rate fx ON o.currency_cd = fx.currency_cd AND o.ord_dt = fx.eff_dt WHERE o.ord_status = 'D' AND YEAR(o.ord_dt) = 2026 GROUP BY c.region_cd ORDER BY total_amount DESC

SELECT p.sku, p.list_prc FROM prod_catalog p JOIN (SELECT categ_cd, AVG(list_prc) AS avg_prc FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd) avg_cat ON p.categ_cd = avg_cat.categ_cd WHERE p.list_prc > avg_cat.avg_prc ORDER BY p.list_prc DESC, p.sku ASC

SELECT i.sku, i.wh_id, i.on_hand_qty FROM inventory i JOIN (SELECT sku, AVG(on_hand_qty) AS avg_qty FROM inventory GROUP BY sku) avg_inv ON i.sku = avg_inv.sku WHERE i.on_hand_qty > avg_inv.avg_qty ORDER BY i.sku, i.wh_id

SELECT ps.sup_id, ps.sku, ps.lead_days FROM prod_supplier ps JOIN (SELECT sku, AVG(lead_days) AS avg_lead FROM prod_supplier GROUP BY sku) avg_s ON ps.sku = avg_s.sku WHERE ps.lead_days > avg_s.avg_lead ORDER BY ps.lead_days DESC, ps.sup_id

SELECT ol.sku, ol.ord_id FROM ord_line ol JOIN (SELECT sku, AVG(unit_prc) AS avg_prc FROM ord_line GROUP BY sku) avg_l ON ol.sku = avg_l.sku WHERE ol.unit_prc > avg_l.avg_prc ORDER BY ol.sku, ol.ord_id

SELECT s.sup_id, s.sup_nm FROM supplier s JOIN prod_supplier ps ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id WHERE ps.sku = 'ELC-024' AND ps.lead_days > (SELECT AVG(lead_days) FROM prod_supplier WHERE sku = 'ELC-024') ORDER BY s.sup_id
SELECT DISTINCT w.wh_id, w.wh_nm FROM warehouse w JOIN inventory i ON w.wh_id = i.wh_id JOIN prod_catalog p ON i.sku = p.sku WHERE p.categ_cd = 'ELC' ORDER BY w.wh_id
SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE disc_flag = 1 ORDER BY sku ASC
SELECT sup_id, sup_nm, country FROM supplier WHERE country = 'US' ORDER BY sup_id ASC
SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'KIT' AND list_prc BETWEEN 50 AND 150 ORDER BY list_prc DESC
SELECT mv_id, mv_ts, qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'ADJ' AND wh_id = 'W1' ORDER BY mv_ts DESC, mv_id ASC
SELECT t1.sup_id, t2.sup_nm FROM prod_supplier AS t1 JOIN supplier AS t2 ON t1.sup_id = t2.sup_id GROUP BY t1.sup_id, t2.sup_nm HAVING COUNT(t1.sku) > 2 ORDER BY t1.sup_id ASC
SELECT t1.sku, t2.prod_nm FROM prod_supplier AS t1 JOIN prod_catalog AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t1.sup_id = 1 AND t1.is_primary = 1 ORDER BY t1.sku ASC
SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY product_count DESC, categ_cd ASC
SELECT t1.wh_id, t1.wh_nm, SUM(t2.on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand FROM warehouse AS t1 JOIN inventory AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id GROUP BY t1.wh_id, t1.wh_nm ORDER BY total_on_hand DESC, t1.wh_id ASC
SELECT t1.sup_id, AVG(t1.lead_days) AS avg_lead_days FROM prod_supplier AS t1 GROUP BY t1.sup_id ORDER BY avg_lead_days ASC, t1.sup_id ASC

SELECT t1.sku, t2.prod_nm FROM inventory AS t1 JOIN prod_catalog AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku GROUP BY t1.sku, t2.prod_nm HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t1.wh_id) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM warehouse) ORDER BY t1.sku ASC

SELECT t1.wh_id, t2.wh_nm FROM inventory AS t1 JOIN warehouse AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id GROUP BY t1.wh_id, t2.wh_nm HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t1.sku) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM prod_catalog) ORDER BY t1.wh_id ASC
SELECT sku, wh_id, MAX(mv_ts) AS mv_ts FROM inv_move GROUP BY sku, wh_id ORDER BY sku ASC, wh_id ASC

SELECT i.sku, i.wh_id, i.on_hand_qty FROM inventory i JOIN (SELECT wh_id, MAX(on_hand_qty) AS max_qty FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id) m ON i.wh_id = m.wh_id AND i.on_hand_qty = m.max_qty ORDER BY i.wh_id ASC

SELECT t.tier_cd, c.cust_id, c.cust_nm, c.signup_dt FROM cust_master c JOIN (SELECT tier_cd, MIN(signup_dt) AS min_dt FROM cust_master GROUP BY tier_cd) t ON c.tier_cd = t.tier_cd AND c.signup_dt = t.min_dt ORDER BY t.tier_cd
SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt, LAG(ord_total_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY cust_id ORDER BY ord_dt, ord_id) AS prev_ord_amount FROM ord_hdr WHERE cust_id = 'C-1006' ORDER BY ord_dt, ord_id

SELECT c.region_cd, SUM(o.ord_total_amt * f.rate_to_usd) * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(oh.ord_total_amt * fx.rate_to_usd) FROM ord_hdr oh JOIN fx_rate fx ON oh.currency_cd = fx.currency_cd AND oh.ord_dt = fx.eff_dt) AS pct_sales FROM ord_hdr o JOIN cust_master c ON o.cust_id = c.cust_id JOIN fx_rate f ON o.currency_cd = f.currency_cd AND o.ord_dt = f.eff_dt GROUP BY c.region_cd
SELECT categ_cd, sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM (SELECT categ_cd, sku, prod_nm, list_prc, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY categ_cd ORDER BY list_prc DESC) AS rnk FROM prod_catalog) t WHERE rnk <= 2
SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE region_cd = 'AP' AND is_actv = 1 AND signup_dt > '2022-07-01'
SELECT AVG(list_prc) FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC'
SELECT tier_cd, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM cust_master GROUP BY tier_cd
SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE disc_flag = 1
SELECT channel_cd, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_revenue FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY channel_cd

SELECT cust_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY cust_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
SELECT o.ord_status, SUM(o.ord_total_amt * f.rate_to_usd) AS total_usd FROM ord_hdr o JOIN fx_rate f ON o.currency_cd = f.currency_cd AND o.ord_dt = f.eff_dt GROUP BY o.ord_status

SELECT region_cd, tier_cd, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM cust_master GROUP BY region_cd, tier_cd

SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE YEAR(signup_dt) = 2022
SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'HOM' AND list_prc < 50.00
SELECT currency_cd, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY currency_cd
SELECT DISTINCT region_cd FROM cust_master

SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE YEAR(ord_dt) = 2026 AND ord_status = 'D'
SELECT rule_key, rule_val, eff_from FROM policy_rule WHERE eff_from <= '2026-04-01' AND (eff_to IS NULL OR eff_to >= '2026-04-01')
SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(*) AS tkt_count FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY tkt_count DESC
SELECT t1.approver_emp_id, SUM(t1.rfd_amt) AS total_approved_amt FROM refund_req t1 WHERE t1.status_cd = 'A' AND t1.approver_emp_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t1.approver_emp_id
SELECT cust_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM ord_hdr WHERE YEAR(ord_dt) = 2026 GROUP BY cust_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
SELECT channel_cd, AVG(ord_total_amt) AS avg_ord_total FROM ord_hdr WHERE YEAR(ord_dt) = 2026 GROUP BY channel_cd
SELECT reason_cd, COUNT(*) AS refund_count FROM refund_req WHERE YEAR(req_dt) IN (2025, 2026) GROUP BY reason_cd
SELECT sev_lvl, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, opened_ts, closed_ts) / 3600.0) AS avg_duration_hours FROM support_tkt WHERE closed_ts IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sev_lvl
SELECT tkt_id, MIN(evt_ts) AS first_evt_ts, MAX(evt_ts) AS last_evt_ts FROM tkt_event GROUP BY tkt_id

SELECT c.cust_id, r.req_dt, r.rfd_amt, SUM(r.rfd_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY c.cust_id ORDER BY r.req_dt, r.rfd_id) AS cumulative_rfd_amt FROM refund_req r JOIN ord_hdr o ON r.ord_id = o.ord_id JOIN cust_master c ON o.cust_id = c.cust_id ORDER BY c.cust_id, r.req_dt
SELECT dept_cd, emp_id, emp_nm, hire_dt FROM (SELECT dept_cd, emp_id, emp_nm, hire_dt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dept_cd ORDER BY hire_dt ASC, emp_id ASC) AS rn FROM emp) t WHERE rn = 1

SELECT tkt_id, evt_id, evt_ts AS current_evt_ts, LAG(evt_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY tkt_id ORDER BY evt_ts, evt_id) AS previous_evt_ts, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, LAG(evt_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY tkt_id ORDER BY evt_ts, evt_id), evt_ts) AS diff_minutes FROM tkt_event

SELECT channel_cd, ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM (SELECT channel_cd, ord_id, ord_total_amt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel_cd ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id ASC) AS rn FROM ord_hdr WHERE YEAR(ord_dt) = 2026) t WHERE rn = 1
SELECT rfd_id, reason_cd, rfd_amt, (rfd_amt / SUM(rfd_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY reason_cd)) * 100 AS percentage_share FROM refund_req

SELECT cust_id, ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM (SELECT cust_id, ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cust_id ORDER BY ord_dt DESC, ord_id DESC) AS rn FROM ord_hdr) t WHERE rn = 1
SELECT reason_cd, rfd_id, rfd_amt FROM (SELECT reason_cd, rfd_id, rfd_amt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY reason_cd ORDER BY rfd_amt DESC, rfd_id ASC) AS rn FROM refund_req) t WHERE rn <= 2

SELECT tkt_id, MIN(evt_ts) AS first_event_timestamp, MAX(evt_ts) AS last_event_timestamp, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, MIN(evt_ts), MAX(evt_ts)) AS duration_seconds FROM tkt_event GROUP BY tkt_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
SELECT tkt_id, evt_id, evt_ts, LEAD(evt_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY tkt_id ORDER BY evt_ts, evt_id) AS next_evt_ts FROM tkt_event
SELECT region_cd, cust_id, cust_nm, signup_dt, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region_cd ORDER BY signup_dt ASC, cust_id ASC) AS rnk FROM cust_master

SELECT assigned_emp_id, tkt_id, opened_ts FROM (SELECT assigned_emp_id, tkt_id, opened_ts, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY assigned_emp_id ORDER BY opened_ts ASC, tkt_id ASC) as rn FROM support_tkt WHERE assigned_emp_id IS NOT NULL) t WHERE rn = 1
SELECT pay_id, ord_id, pay_amt FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' AND currency_cd = 'USD'
SELECT ship_id, ord_id, ship_dt FROM shipment WHERE carrier_cd = 'DHL'
SELECT method_cd, SUM(pay_amt) AS total_pay_amt FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' AND currency_cd = 'USD' GROUP BY method_cd
SELECT wh_id, AVG(on_hand_qty) AS avg_on_hand_qty FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-03-31'
SELECT w.wh_nm, COUNT(m.mv_id) AS total_movements FROM warehouse w LEFT JOIN inv_move m ON w.wh_id = m.wh_id GROUP BY w.wh_id, w.wh_nm

SELECT h.ord_id, h.ord_total_amt, MAX(p.pay_amt) AS max_pay_amt FROM ord_hdr h JOIN payment p ON h.ord_id = p.ord_id WHERE h.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND h.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY h.ord_id, h.ord_total_amt
SELECT carrier_cd, COUNT(*) AS delivered_count FROM shipment WHERE ship_status = 'D' AND deliv_dt >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY carrier_cd
SELECT w.wh_nm, SUM(m.qty) AS total_qty_moved FROM warehouse w JOIN inv_move m ON w.wh_id = m.wh_id WHERE m.mv_type = 'IN' GROUP BY w.wh_id, w.wh_nm
SELECT categ_cd, prod_nm, list_prc FROM (SELECT categ_cd, prod_nm, list_prc, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY categ_cd ORDER BY list_prc DESC, prod_nm ASC) as rnk FROM prod_catalog) t WHERE rnk = 1
SELECT currency_cd, paid_ts, pay_id, SUM(pay_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY currency_cd ORDER BY paid_ts, pay_id) AS running_total FROM payment
SELECT wh_id, sku, on_hand_qty FROM (SELECT wh_id, sku, on_hand_qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wh_id ORDER BY on_hand_qty DESC, sku ASC) as rn FROM inventory) t WHERE rn <= 2

SELECT ord_id, pay_id, paid_ts, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, LAG(paid_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY ord_id ORDER BY paid_ts, pay_id), paid_ts) AS gap_seconds FROM payment WHERE ord_id IN (SELECT ord_id FROM payment GROUP BY ord_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)
SELECT currency_cd, pay_id, pay_amt FROM (SELECT currency_cd, pay_id, pay_amt, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY currency_cd ORDER BY pay_amt DESC, pay_id ASC) as rnk FROM payment) t WHERE rnk <= 3
SELECT currency_cd, paid_ts, pay_amt FROM (SELECT currency_cd, paid_ts, pay_amt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY currency_cd ORDER BY paid_ts ASC, pay_id ASC) as rn FROM payment) t WHERE rn = 1
SELECT wh_id, MAX(mv_ts) AS max_mv_ts FROM inv_move GROUP BY wh_id

SELECT p.sku, p.categ_cd, p.list_prc, (p.list_prc - a.avg_prc) AS price_diff FROM prod_catalog p JOIN (SELECT categ_cd, AVG(list_prc) as avg_prc FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd) a ON p.categ_cd = a.categ_cd

SELECT DISTINCT cust_id, ord_id, ord_dt, ord_status FROM (SELECT cust_id, ord_id, ord_dt, ord_status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cust_id ORDER BY ord_dt ASC, ord_id ASC) as rn_first, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cust_id ORDER BY ord_dt DESC, ord_id DESC) as rn_last FROM ord_hdr) t WHERE rn_first = 1 OR rn_last = 1
SELECT carrier_cd, ship_id, ord_id, ship_dt, LAG(ship_dt) OVER (PARTITION BY carrier_cd ORDER BY ship_dt, ship_id) AS prev_ship_dt FROM shipment
SELECT promo_cd, promo_nm FROM promo WHERE starts_dt >= '2025-11-01' ORDER BY promo_id

SELECT cust_id, month_dt FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE segment_cd = 'VIP' AND month_dt = '2026-07-01'
SELECT promo_id, promo_cd, disc_pct FROM promo WHERE disc_pct > 15.00 ORDER BY disc_pct DESC, promo_id ASC
SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE signup_dt > '2022-08-31' AND region_cd = 'AP' ORDER BY signup_dt

SELECT cust_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM (SELECT cust_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cust_id ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id DESC) as rn FROM ord_hdr WHERE YEAR(ord_dt) = 2026) t WHERE rn = 1
SELECT cust_id, month_dt, segment_cd FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE YEAR(month_dt) = 2026 ORDER BY cust_id, month_dt
SELECT t1.promo_cd, COUNT(t2.ord_id) AS order_cnt FROM promo t1 LEFT JOIN ord_promo t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id GROUP BY t1.promo_id, t1.promo_cd ORDER BY order_cnt DESC, t1.promo_id ASC
SELECT cust_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt, SUM(ord_total_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY cust_id ORDER BY ord_dt, ord_id) AS running_total FROM ord_hdr
SELECT cust_id, month_dt, segment_cd, LAG(segment_cd) OVER (PARTITION BY cust_id ORDER BY month_dt) AS prev_segment_cd FROM cust_segment_hist
SELECT cust_id, ord_id, ord_total_amt, (ord_total_amt / SUM(ord_total_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY cust_id)) * 100 AS pct_of_cust_total FROM ord_hdr
SELECT cust_id, month_dt, segment_cd FROM (SELECT cust_id, month_dt, segment_cd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cust_id ORDER BY month_dt ASC) as rn FROM cust_segment_hist) t WHERE rn = 1

SELECT promo_id, ord_id, rnk FROM (SELECT op.promo_id, op.ord_id, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY op.promo_id ORDER BY oh.ord_dt DESC, oh.ord_id DESC) AS rnk FROM ord_promo op JOIN ord_hdr oh ON op.ord_id = oh.ord_id) t WHERE rnk <= 2
SELECT cust_id, ord_id, ord_dt FROM (SELECT cust_id, ord_id, ord_dt, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cust_id ORDER BY ord_dt DESC, ord_id DESC) as rnk FROM ord_hdr) t WHERE rnk = 1
SELECT cust_id, segment_cd, month_dt FROM (SELECT cust_id, segment_cd, month_dt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cust_id ORDER BY month_dt DESC) AS rn FROM cust_segment_hist) t WHERE rn = 1

SELECT cust_id, ord_id, ord_dt, LEAD(ord_dt) OVER (PARTITION BY cust_id ORDER BY ord_dt, ord_id) AS next_ord_dt FROM ord_hdr
SELECT mv_id, sku, wh_id, mv_ts, qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'IN'
