SELECT t1.categ_cd, t1.sku, t1.prod_nm, t1.list_prc FROM prod_catalog t1 JOIN (SELECT categ_cd, AVG(list_prc) AS avg_prc FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd) t2 ON t1.categ_cd = t2.categ_cd WHERE t1.list_prc > t2.avg_prc

SELECT i.sku, p.prod_nm, i.wh_id, i.on_hand_qty FROM inventory i JOIN prod_catalog p ON i.sku = p.sku JOIN (SELECT wh_id, AVG(on_hand_qty) AS avg_qty FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id) a ON i.wh_id = a.wh_id WHERE i.on_hand_qty > a.avg_qty

SELECT s.sup_nm, ps.sku, ps.lead_days FROM prod_supplier ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.sup_id = s.sup_id JOIN (SELECT sup_id, MIN(lead_days) AS min_lead FROM prod_supplier GROUP BY sup_id) m ON ps.sup_id = m.sup_id AND ps.lead_days = m.min_lead

SELECT categ_cd, sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM (SELECT categ_cd, sku, prod_nm, list_prc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY categ_cd ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku ASC) as rn FROM prod_catalog) t WHERE rn = 1
SELECT sup_id, sku, lead_days, lead_days - LAG(lead_days) OVER (PARTITION BY sup_id ORDER BY sku) AS lead_days_diff FROM prod_supplier

SELECT i.wh_id, i.sku, i.on_hand_qty, (i.on_hand_qty / t.tot_qty) * 100 AS pct_of_wh FROM inventory i JOIN (SELECT wh_id, SUM(on_hand_qty) AS tot_qty FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id) t ON i.wh_id = t.wh_id
SELECT sup_id, sku, lead_days FROM (SELECT sup_id, sku, lead_days, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sup_id ORDER BY lead_days DESC, sku ASC) as rn FROM prod_supplier) t WHERE rn <= 2

SELECT categ_cd, sku, prod_nm, list_prc, rnk FROM (SELECT categ_cd, sku, prod_nm, list_prc, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY categ_cd ORDER BY list_prc DESC) as rnk FROM prod_catalog) t WHERE rnk IN (1, 2)
SELECT sku, mv_ts, qty, LAG(mv_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY sku ORDER BY mv_ts, mv_id) AS prev_mv_ts FROM inv_move WHERE wh_id = 'W1'
SELECT wh_id, sku, on_hand_qty FROM (SELECT wh_id, sku, on_hand_qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wh_id ORDER BY on_hand_qty DESC, sku DESC) as rn FROM inventory) t WHERE rn = 1

SELECT m.month_dt, COALESCE(SUM(o.ord_total_amt * f.rate_to_usd), 0) AS total_revenue_usd FROM (SELECT DATE '2026-01-01' AS month_dt UNION SELECT DATE '2026-02-01' UNION SELECT DATE '2026-03-01' UNION SELECT DATE '2026-04-01' UNION SELECT DATE '2026-05-01' UNION SELECT DATE '2026-06-01' UNION SELECT DATE '2026-07-01' UNION SELECT DATE '2026-08-01' UNION SELECT DATE '2026-09-01' UNION SELECT DATE '2026-10-01' UNION SELECT DATE '2026-11-01' UNION SELECT DATE '2026-12-01') m LEFT JOIN ord_hdr o ON EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.ord_dt) = 2026 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.ord_dt) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m.month_dt) LEFT JOIN fx_rate f ON o.currency_cd = f.currency_cd AND o.ord_dt = f.eff_dt GROUP BY m.month_dt ORDER BY m.month_dt

SELECT c.cust_nm, o.ord_id, o.ord_total_amt * f.rate_to_usd AS ord_total_usd FROM ord_hdr o JOIN cust_master c ON o.cust_id = c.cust_id JOIN fx_rate f ON o.currency_cd = f.currency_cd AND o.ord_dt = f.eff_dt WHERE o.channel_cd = 'APP' AND o.ord_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-04-30' ORDER BY ord_total_usd DESC, o.ord_id ASC

SELECT o.channel_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT o.ord_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.ord_total_amt * f.rate_to_usd) AS revenue_usd FROM ord_hdr o JOIN fx_rate f ON o.currency_cd = f.currency_cd AND o.ord_dt = f.eff_dt WHERE o.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY o.channel_cd ORDER BY revenue_usd DESC

SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm, SUM(l.qty) AS total_units FROM ord_line l JOIN ord_hdr h ON l.ord_id = h.ord_id JOIN prod_catalog p ON l.sku = p.sku WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM h.ord_dt) = 2026 AND h.ord_status IN ('S', 'D') GROUP BY p.sku, p.prod_nm ORDER BY total_units DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT tier_cd, COUNT(*) AS active_cust_count FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND signup_dt <= '2026-06-30' GROUP BY tier_cd

SELECT 'November' AS month_name, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.ord_dt) = 2025 THEN o.ord_total_amt * f.rate_to_usd ELSE 0 END) AS rev_2025, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.ord_dt) = 2026 THEN o.ord_total_amt * f.rate_to_usd ELSE 0 END) AS rev_2026 FROM ord_hdr o JOIN fx_rate f ON o.currency_cd = f.currency_cd AND o.ord_dt = f.eff_dt WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.ord_dt) = 11 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.ord_dt) IN (2025, 2026)

SELECT c.tier_cd, AVG(o.ord_total_amt * f.rate_to_usd) AS avg_ord_amt_usd FROM ord_hdr o JOIN cust_master c ON o.cust_id = c.cust_id JOIN fx_rate f ON o.currency_cd = f.currency_cd AND o.ord_dt = f.eff_dt WHERE o.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY c.tier_cd ORDER BY avg_ord_amt_usd DESC
SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND list_prc > 50.00 ORDER BY list_prc DESC

SELECT DATE_SUB('2026-04-28', INTERVAL n WEEK) AS week_start, COUNT(DISTINCT o.ord_id) AS order_volume, SUM(o.ord_total_amt * f.rate_to_usd) AS gross_sales_usd FROM ord_hdr o JOIN fx_rate f ON o.currency_cd = f.currency_cd AND o.ord_dt = f.eff_dt JOIN (SELECT 0 AS n UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3) weeks ON o.ord_dt > DATE_SUB('2026-04-28', INTERVAL n + 1 WEEK) AND o.ord_dt <= DATE_SUB('2026-04-28', INTERVAL n WEEK) GROUP BY week_start ORDER BY week_start
SELECT region_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) AS unique_customers FROM cust_master WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM signup_dt) = 2025 GROUP BY region_cd ORDER BY region_cd

SELECT SUM(l.qty) AS total_qty_ordered, SUM(l.qty * l.unit_prc * (l.disc_pct / 100.0)) AS total_discount_given FROM ord_line l JOIN ord_hdr h ON l.ord_id = h.ord_id JOIN prod_catalog p ON l.sku = p.sku WHERE p.categ_cd = 'KIT' AND h.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-01-31'
SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE tier_cd = 'P' AND signup_dt < '2025-01-01'

SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM COALESCE(o25.ord_dt, o26.ord_dt)) AS month_num, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o25.ord_dt) = 2025 THEN o25.ord_total_amt * f25.rate_to_usd ELSE 0 END) AS rev_2025, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o26.ord_dt) = 2026 THEN o26.ord_total_amt * f26.rate_to_usd ELSE 0 END) AS rev_2026 FROM ord_hdr o25 LEFT JOIN fx_rate f25 ON o25.currency_cd = f25.currency_cd AND o25.ord_dt = f25.eff_dt AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o25.ord_dt) = 2025 LEFT JOIN ord_hdr o26 ON EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o25.ord_dt) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o26.ord_dt) AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o26.ord_dt) = 2026 LEFT JOIN fx_rate f26 ON o26.currency_cd = f26.currency_cd AND o26.ord_dt = f26.eff_dt WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o25.ord_dt) = 2025 GROUP BY month_num ORDER BY month_num
SELECT CONCAT('Q', QUARTER(ord_dt)) AS quarter_name, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY QUARTER(ord_dt) ORDER BY quarter_name

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS year_month, COUNT(o.ord_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.ord_total_amt * COALESCE(f.rate_to_usd, 1)) AS total_sales_usd FROM ord_hdr o LEFT JOIN fx_rate f ON o.currency_cd = f.currency_cd AND o.ord_dt = f.eff_dt WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2025-05-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-10-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY year_month DESC

SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm HAVING COUNT(o.ord_id) > 3 ORDER BY COUNT(o.ord_id) DESC
SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT p.categ_cd, SUM(l.qty * l.unit_prc * (1 - l.disc_pct / 100) * COALESCE(f.rate_to_usd, 1)) AS total_revenue FROM ord_hdr o JOIN ord_line l ON o.ord_id = l.ord_id JOIN prod_catalog p ON l.sku = p.sku LEFT JOIN fx_rate f ON o.currency_cd = f.currency_cd AND o.ord_dt = f.eff_dt WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-05-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY p.categ_cd ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT ord_status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY ord_status ORDER BY order_count DESC

SELECT STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(YEAR(ord_dt), '_', WEEK(ord_dt, 1), ' 1'), '%X_%V %W') AS week_start, COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) AS unique_cust_count FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-10-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-10-31' GROUP BY YEAR(ord_dt), WEEK(ord_dt, 1) ORDER BY week_start

SELECT p.categ_cd, AVG(l.disc_pct) AS avg_disc_pct FROM ord_line l JOIN ord_hdr o ON l.ord_id = o.ord_id JOIN prod_catalog p ON l.sku = p.sku WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY p.categ_cd
SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND region_cd = 'NA' AND tier_cd = 'G'

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(req_dt, '%Y-%m-01') AS month_start, SUM(rfd_amt) AS total_rfd_amt FROM refund_req WHERE req_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND req_dt <= '2026-06-30' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(req_dt, '%Y-%m-01') ORDER BY month_start ASC

SELECT DATE_ADD(opened_ts, INTERVAL(-WEEKDAY(opened_ts)) DAY) AS week_start, COUNT(*) AS tkt_count FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY week_start ORDER BY week_start

SELECT CONCAT('Q', QUARTER(ord_dt)) AS quarter_name, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_amount FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY QUARTER(ord_dt) ORDER BY quarter_name

SELECT YEAR(ord_dt) AS yr, QUARTER(ord_dt) AS qtr, SUM(ord_total_amt * COALESCE(f.rate_to_usd, 1)) AS total_revenue FROM ord_hdr o LEFT JOIN fx_rate f ON o.currency_cd = f.currency_cd AND o.ord_dt = f.eff_dt WHERE (o.ord_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2025-03-31') OR (o.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-03-31') GROUP BY YEAR(ord_dt), QUARTER(ord_dt) ORDER BY yr, qtr
SELECT MONTH(ord_dt) AS month_no, COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY MONTH(ord_dt) ORDER BY month_no

SELECT YEAR(decided_dt) AS yr, MONTH(decided_dt) AS mo, COUNT(*) AS approved_count FROM refund_req WHERE status_cd = 'A' AND decided_dt >= '2025-10-01' AND decided_dt <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY YEAR(decided_dt), MONTH(decided_dt) ORDER BY yr, mo

SELECT o1.ord_dt, SUM(o2.ord_total_amt) AS trailing_30_total FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ord_dt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2025-11-01' AND ord_dt <= '2025-11-30') o1 JOIN ord_hdr o2 ON o2.ord_dt BETWEEN DATE_SUB(o1.ord_dt, INTERVAL 29 DAY) AND o1.ord_dt GROUP BY o1.ord_dt ORDER BY o1.ord_dt

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(signup_dt, '%Y-%m') AS month_str, COUNT(*) AS signup_count FROM cust_master WHERE signup_dt >= '2022-07-01' AND signup_dt <= '2022-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(signup_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month_str ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(opened_ts, '%Y-%m') AS year_month, COUNT(*) AS tkt_count FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts <= '2026-12-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(opened_ts, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY year_month

SELECT YEAR(req_dt) AS yr, SUM(rfd_amt) AS total_refunds FROM refund_req WHERE (req_dt >= '2025-11-01' AND req_dt <= '2025-11-30') OR (req_dt >= '2026-11-01' AND req_dt <= '2026-11-30') GROUP BY YEAR(req_dt) ORDER BY yr

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS year_month, COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) AS distinct_customers FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY year_month

SELECT DATE_ADD(e.evt_ts, INTERVAL(-WEEKDAY(e.evt_ts)) DAY) AS week_start, COUNT(*) AS close_count FROM tkt_event e WHERE e.evt_type = 'CLOSE' AND e.evt_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND e.evt_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY week_start ORDER BY week_start
SELECT channel_cd, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_amount FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2025-10-01' AND ord_dt <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY total_amount DESC
SELECT DATE(opened_ts) AS tkt_date, COUNT(*) AS tkt_count FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts <= '2026-04-07 23:59:59' GROUP BY DATE(opened_ts) ORDER BY tkt_date

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(req_dt, '%Y-%m') AS year_month, AVG(rfd_amt) AS avg_rfd_amt FROM refund_req WHERE req_dt >= '2025-10-01' AND req_dt <= '2026-03-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(req_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY year_month
SELECT QUARTER(ord_dt) AS quarter_num, COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY QUARTER(ord_dt) ORDER BY quarter_num ASC;
SELECT QUARTER(opened_ts) AS quarter_num, COUNT(*) AS ticket_count FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-04-01' AND opened_ts < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY QUARTER(opened_ts) ORDER BY quarter_num ASC;

SELECT YEAR(ord_dt) AS ord_year, MONTH(ord_dt) AS ord_month, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_order_val FROM ord_hdr WHERE currency_cd = 'EUR' AND ord_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY YEAR(ord_dt), MONTH(ord_dt) ORDER BY ord_year, ord_month;

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(req_dt, '%Y-%m') AS req_month, COUNT(*) AS refund_count FROM refund_req WHERE reason_cd = 'DMG' AND req_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND req_dt <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(req_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY req_month ASC;

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS sales_month, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_amount FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT YEAR(hire_dt) AS hire_year, COUNT(*) AS emp_count FROM emp WHERE hire_dt >= '2018-01-01' AND hire_dt <= '2021-12-31' GROUP BY YEAR(hire_dt) ORDER BY hire_year ASC;
SELECT sev_lvl, COUNT(*) AS ticket_count FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY sev_lvl ORDER BY sev_lvl ASC;

SELECT DATE_SUB(req_dt, INTERVAL WEEKDAY(req_dt) DAY) AS week_start_dt, COUNT(*) AS request_count FROM refund_req WHERE req_dt >= '2025-11-01' AND req_dt <= '2025-11-30' GROUP BY week_start_dt ORDER BY week_start_dt ASC;

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.opened_ts, '%Y-%m') AS ticket_month, COUNT(*) AS ticket_count FROM support_tkt t JOIN emp e ON t.assigned_emp_id = e.emp_id WHERE e.dept_cd = 'SUP' AND t.opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND t.opened_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(t.opened_ts, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY ticket_month ASC;

SELECT p.method_cd, COUNT(*) AS payment_count, SUM(p.pay_amt) AS total_payment_amt FROM payment p JOIN ord_hdr o ON p.ord_id = o.ord_id WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-01-31' GROUP BY p.method_cd ORDER BY total_payment_amt DESC, p.method_cd ASC;
SELECT w.wh_nm, SUM(i.on_hand_qty) AS total_qty FROM warehouse w JOIN inventory i ON w.wh_id = i.wh_id GROUP BY w.wh_id, w.wh_nm ORDER BY total_qty DESC, w.wh_nm ASC;

SELECT carrier_cd, COUNT(*) AS shipment_count FROM shipment WHERE ship_status = 'D' AND ship_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ship_dt <= '2026-03-31' GROUP BY carrier_cd ORDER BY shipment_count DESC, carrier_cd ASC;

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS year_month, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_order_amount FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY year_month ASC;

SELECT ord_status, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_amount, AVG(ord_total_amt) AS average_amount FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-06-30' GROUP BY ord_status ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT w.wh_nm, SUM(i.on_hand_qty) AS total_qty FROM inventory i JOIN warehouse w ON i.wh_id = w.wh_id JOIN prod_catalog p ON i.sku = p.sku WHERE p.categ_cd = 'ELC' GROUP BY w.wh_id, w.wh_nm ORDER BY total_qty DESC LIMIT 3;
SELECT pay_status, COUNT(*) AS attempt_count FROM payment WHERE paid_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND paid_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY pay_status ORDER BY attempt_count DESC;
SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_revenue FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-06-30' GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;
SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE list_prc > 75.00 AND disc_flag = 0 ORDER BY list_prc DESC;

SELECT DATE_SUB(s.ship_dt, INTERVAL WEEKDAY(s.ship_dt) DAY) AS week_start_dt, COUNT(*) AS shipment_count FROM shipment s JOIN warehouse w ON s.wh_id = w.wh_id WHERE w.wh_nm = 'Newark Hub' AND s.ship_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND s.ship_dt <= '2026-01-31' GROUP BY week_start_dt ORDER BY week_start_dt ASC;
SELECT ship_id, ord_id, wh_id, deliv_dt FROM shipment WHERE carrier_cd = 'DHL' AND ship_status = 'D' AND deliv_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND deliv_dt <= '2026-04-30' ORDER BY deliv_dt ASC;
SELECT p.categ_cd, AVG(i.on_hand_qty) AS avg_on_hand, AVG(i.reorder_pt) AS avg_reorder_pt FROM inventory i JOIN prod_catalog p ON i.sku = p.sku GROUP BY p.categ_cd ORDER BY p.categ_cd ASC;
SELECT pay_id, ord_id, pay_amt, paid_ts FROM payment WHERE method_cd = 'CC' AND pay_amt > 200.00 AND paid_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND paid_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59' ORDER BY paid_ts ASC;
SELECT currency_cd, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_revenue FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-07-31' GROUP BY currency_cd ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;
SELECT sku, wh_id, on_hand_qty, reorder_pt FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt ORDER BY sku ASC, wh_id ASC;

SELECT t1.mv_type, COUNT(*) AS movement_count FROM inv_move t1 JOIN warehouse t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id WHERE t2.wh_nm = 'Rotterdam Hub' AND t1.mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND t1.mv_ts < '2025-11-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY t1.mv_type ORDER BY movement_count DESC

SELECT currency_cd, SUM(pay_amt) AS total_settled_amt FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' AND paid_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND paid_ts < '2025-12-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY currency_cd ORDER BY total_settled_amt DESC

SELECT carrier_cd, DATE_FORMAT(ship_dt, '%Y-%m') AS year_month, COUNT(*) AS shipment_count FROM shipment WHERE ship_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ship_dt < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY carrier_cd, DATE_FORMAT(ship_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY carrier_cd, year_month
SELECT ord_id, cust_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'STR' AND ord_total_amt > 500.00 AND ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-10-31' ORDER BY ord_dt ASC
SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'KIT' ORDER BY list_prc DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_amount FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-04-30' GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY order_count DESC

SELECT t1.wh_id, t2.wh_nm, SUM(t1.qty) AS total_units_in FROM inv_move t1 JOIN warehouse t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id WHERE t1.mv_type = 'IN' AND t1.mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND t1.mv_ts < '2025-11-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY t1.wh_id, t2.wh_nm ORDER BY total_units_in DESC

SELECT t2.promo_cd, COUNT(t1.ord_id) AS order_count FROM ord_promo t1 JOIN promo t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr t3 ON t1.ord_id = t3.ord_id WHERE t3.ord_dt >= '2025-11-01' AND t3.ord_dt <= '2026-03-31' GROUP BY t2.promo_cd ORDER BY order_count DESC, t2.promo_cd ASC
SELECT channel_cd, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_amount FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-04-30' GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY total_amount DESC
SELECT tier_cd, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND signup_dt >= '2022-01-01' AND signup_dt <= '2022-12-31' GROUP BY tier_cd ORDER BY tier_cd ASC
SELECT t1.cust_nm, t2.ord_dt FROM cust_master t1 JOIN ord_hdr t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.cust_id = 'C-1001' AND t2.channel_cd = 'WEB' ORDER BY t2.ord_dt ASC
SELECT promo_nm, disc_pct FROM promo WHERE starts_dt >= '2026-01-01' ORDER BY disc_pct DESC, promo_nm ASC
SELECT evt_type, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM web_event WHERE channel_cd = 'APP' AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts < '2025-12-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY evt_type ORDER BY evt_type ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(month_dt, '%Y-%m') AS month_str, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE segment_cd = 'VIP' AND month_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND month_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(month_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month_str ASC

SELECT t1.region_cd, COUNT(t1.cust_id) AS total_customers, SUM(CASE WHEN t2.segment_cd = 'VIP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vip_count FROM cust_master t1 LEFT JOIN cust_segment_hist t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id AND t2.month_dt = '2026-07-01' WHERE t1.is_actv = 1 GROUP BY t1.region_cd ORDER BY t1.region_cd ASC

SELECT t2.promo_cd, t2.promo_nm, SUM(t3.ord_total_amt) AS total_order_amount FROM ord_promo t1 JOIN promo t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr t3 ON t1.ord_id = t3.ord_id WHERE t3.ord_dt >= '2025-11-01' AND t3.ord_dt <= '2026-06-30' GROUP BY t2.promo_cd, t2.promo_nm ORDER BY total_order_amount DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ord_month, COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) AS unique_customers FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-06-30' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY ord_month ASC

SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(*) AS total_event_count, COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS unique_sessions FROM web_event WHERE channel_cd IN ('WEB', 'APP') AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts < '2025-12-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY channel_cd ASC

SELECT t1.cust_id, t2.cust_nm, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM ord_hdr t1 JOIN cust_master t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.currency_cd = 'USD' AND t1.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND t1.ord_dt <= '2026-06-30' GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t2.cust_nm HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY order_count DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(month_dt, '%Y-%m') AS month_str, segment_cd, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE month_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND month_dt <= '2026-06-30' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(month_dt, '%Y-%m'), segment_cd ORDER BY month_str ASC, segment_cd ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t1.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS month_str, SUM(t1.ord_total_amt) AS total_purchase_amount, COUNT(t2.evt_id) AS purchase_event_count FROM ord_hdr t1 JOIN web_event t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id AND t2.evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND DATE_FORMAT(t1.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(t2.evt_ts, '%Y-%m') WHERE t1.ord_dt >= '2025-11-01' AND t1.ord_dt <= '2026-04-30' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(t1.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month_str ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS month_str, SUM(CASE WHEN channel_cd = 'WEB' THEN ord_total_amt ELSE 0 END) AS web_order_total, SUM(CASE WHEN channel_cd = 'APP' THEN ord_total_amt ELSE 0 END) AS app_order_total FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-04-30' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month_str ASC

SELECT DISTINCT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master t1 JOIN cust_segment_hist t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id JOIN ord_hdr t3 ON t1.cust_id = t3.cust_id WHERE t2.month_dt = '2026-01-01' AND t2.segment_cd = 'VIP' AND t3.ord_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND t3.ord_dt <= '2026-04-30' ORDER BY t1.cust_nm ASC

SELECT t2.promo_cd, (SUM(CASE WHEN t3.ord_total_amt > 200.00 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS pct_over_200 FROM ord_promo t1 JOIN promo t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr t3 ON t1.ord_id = t3.ord_id WHERE t3.ord_dt >= '2025-11-01' AND t3.ord_dt <= '2026-06-30' GROUP BY t2.promo_cd ORDER BY pct_over_200 DESC

SELECT c.cust_nm, c.signup_dt, o.ord_total_amt
FROM cust_master c
JOIN (
  SELECT cust_id, ord_total_amt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cust_id ORDER BY ord_dt ASC, ord_id ASC) as rn
  FROM ord_hdr
  WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31'
) o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id AND o.rn = 1
WHERE c.is_actv = 1 AND c.region_cd = 'NA'
ORDER BY c.signup_dt ASC;

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(w.evt_ts, '%Y-%m') AS month_val,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN w.evt_type = 'VIEW' THEN w.session_id END) AS view_sessions,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN w.evt_type = 'CHECKOUT' THEN w.session_id END) AS checkout_sessions
FROM web_event w
WHERE w.evt_ts >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AND w.evt_ts < '2026-04-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(w.evt_ts, '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY month_val ASC;

SELECT p.promo_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT o.cust_id) AS distinct_cust_count
FROM promo p
JOIN ord_promo op ON p.promo_id = op.promo_id
JOIN ord_hdr o ON op.ord_id = o.ord_id
WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2025-11-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-03-31'
GROUP BY p.promo_id, p.promo_nm
ORDER BY distinct_cust_count DESC, p.promo_nm ASC;

SELECT c.tier_cd, AVG(o.ord_total_amt) AS avg_ord_total
FROM ord_hdr o
JOIN cust_master c ON o.cust_id = c.cust_id
WHERE o.currency_cd = 'USD'
  AND o.ord_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-04-30'
GROUP BY c.tier_cd
ORDER BY avg_ord_total DESC;

SELECT segment_cd, COUNT(*) AS segment_count
FROM cust_segment_hist
WHERE month_dt = '2026-06-01'
GROUP BY segment_cd
ORDER BY segment_count DESC;

SELECT c.cust_nm, COUNT(w.evt_id) AS purchase_event_count
FROM cust_master c
JOIN web_event w ON c.cust_id = w.cust_id
WHERE c.region_cd = 'EU'
  AND w.evt_type = 'PURCHASE'
  AND w.evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND w.evt_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59'
GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm
ORDER BY purchase_event_count DESC, c.cust_nm ASC;

SELECT p.promo_cd, p.disc_pct, COUNT(op.ord_id) AS app_count
FROM promo p
LEFT JOIN ord_promo op ON p.promo_id = op.promo_id
WHERE p.starts_dt <= '2026-10-31' AND p.ends_dt >= '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY p.promo_id, p.promo_cd, p.disc_pct
ORDER BY p.disc_pct DESC, p.promo_cd ASC;

SELECT i.sku, i.on_hand_qty
FROM inventory i
WHERE i.wh_id = 'W1'
ORDER BY i.sku ASC;

SELECT s.sup_nm, ps.lead_days
FROM prod_supplier ps
JOIN supplier s ON ps.sup_id = s.sup_id
WHERE ps.sku = 'ELC-025'
ORDER BY ps.lead_days ASC, s.sup_nm ASC;

SELECT prod_nm, list_prc
FROM prod_catalog
WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND disc_flag = 1
ORDER BY list_prc DESC;

SELECT sku, on_hand_qty, reorder_pt
FROM inventory
WHERE wh_id = 'W2' AND on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt
ORDER BY sku ASC;

SELECT s.sup_nm, s.country
FROM prod_supplier ps
JOIN supplier s ON ps.sup_id = s.sup_id
JOIN prod_catalog p ON ps.sku = p.sku
WHERE ps.is_primary = 1 AND p.categ_cd = 'OFC'
GROUP BY s.sup_id, s.sup_nm, s.country
ORDER BY s.sup_nm ASC;

SELECT w.wh_nm, SUM(i.on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand
FROM warehouse w
JOIN inventory i ON w.wh_id = i.wh_id
GROUP BY w.wh_id, w.wh_nm
ORDER BY total_on_hand DESC;

SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm
FROM prod_catalog p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM inv_move m
  WHERE m.sku = p.sku AND m.mv_type = 'OUT'
)
ORDER BY p.sku ASC;

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(mv_ts, '%Y-%m') AS month_val, wh_id, SUM(qty) AS total_in_qty
FROM inv_move
WHERE mv_type = 'IN' AND mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND mv_ts <= '2025-12-31 23:59:59'
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(mv_ts, '%Y-%m'), wh_id
ORDER BY month_val ASC, wh_id ASC;

SELECT w.wh_nm, SUM(m.qty) AS net_qty
FROM inv_move m
JOIN warehouse w ON m.wh_id = w.wh_id
WHERE m.mv_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND m.mv_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59'
GROUP BY w.wh_id, w.wh_nm
ORDER BY net_qty DESC;

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(h.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS month_val, p.categ_cd,
       SUM(l.qty * l.unit_prc * (1 - l.disc_pct / 100.0)) AS total_revenue
FROM ord_hdr h
JOIN ord_line l ON h.ord_id = l.ord_id
JOIN prod_catalog p ON l.sku = p.sku
WHERE h.ord_dt >= '2025-10-01' AND h.ord_dt <= '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(h.ord_dt, '%Y-%m'), p.categ_cd
ORDER BY month_val ASC, p.categ_cd ASC;

SELECT l.sku, SUM(l.qty) AS total_units_ordered
FROM ord_line l
JOIN ord_hdr h ON l.ord_id = h.ord_id
JOIN prod_catalog p ON l.sku = p.sku
WHERE h.ord_dt >= '2025-10-01' AND h.ord_dt <= '2025-12-31'
  AND p.list_prc > 50.00
GROUP BY l.sku
ORDER BY total_units_ordered DESC, l.sku ASC;

SELECT s.sup_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.sku) AS distinct_products, AVG(ps.lead_days) AS avg_lead_days
FROM supplier s
JOIN prod_supplier ps ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id
GROUP BY s.sup_id, s.sup_nm
ORDER BY s.sup_nm ASC;

SELECT wh_id, COUNT(DISTINCT sku) AS sku_count
FROM inventory
WHERE on_hand_qty > 500
GROUP BY wh_id
ORDER BY wh_id ASC;

SELECT categ_cd, AVG(list_prc) AS avg_list_prc
FROM prod_catalog
GROUP BY categ_cd
HAVING AVG(list_prc) > 40.00
ORDER BY avg_list_prc DESC;

SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN m.qty < 0 THEN -m.qty ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_out_qty
FROM prod_catalog p
LEFT JOIN inv_move m ON p.sku = m.sku AND m.mv_type = 'OUT'
WHERE p.categ_cd = 'HOM'
GROUP BY p.sku, p.prod_nm
ORDER BY total_out_qty DESC, p.sku ASC;

SELECT wh_id, SUM(reorder_pt) AS total_reorder_pt
FROM inventory
GROUP BY wh_id
ORDER BY wh_id ASC;

SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(*) AS discontinued_count
FROM prod_catalog
WHERE disc_flag = 1
GROUP BY categ_cd
ORDER BY categ_cd ASC;

SELECT s.sup_nm, COUNT(p.sku) AS primary_count FROM supplier s JOIN prod_supplier p ON s.sup_id = p.sup_id WHERE p.is_primary = 1 GROUP BY s.sup_id, s.sup_nm HAVING COUNT(p.sku) > 2 ORDER BY primary_count DESC, s.sup_nm ASC
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(mv_ts, '%Y-%m') AS month_str, SUM(qty) AS total_qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'ADJ' AND mv_ts >= '2025-10-01' AND mv_ts < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY month_str ORDER BY month_str ASC
SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND region_cd = 'AP' AND signup_dt <= '2022-07-02' ORDER BY signup_dt ASC, cust_id ASC
SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE disc_flag = 1 AND categ_cd = 'ELC' AND list_prc > 50.00 ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku ASC
SELECT ord_id, cust_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'APP' AND ord_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND ord_total_amt > 300.00 ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id ASC
SELECT ord_id, ord_dt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_status = 'D' AND channel_cd = 'WEB' AND ord_dt >= '2026-06-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-06-30' ORDER BY ord_dt ASC, ord_id ASC
SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(*) AS high_priced_count FROM prod_catalog WHERE list_prc > 100.00 GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY high_priced_count DESC, categ_cd ASC
SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm, SUM(l.qty) AS total_qty FROM ord_line l JOIN prod_catalog p ON l.sku = p.sku WHERE l.qty >= 3 GROUP BY p.sku, p.prod_nm ORDER BY total_qty DESC, p.sku ASC
SELECT h.channel_cd, SUM(l.qty) AS total_qty FROM ord_line l JOIN ord_hdr h ON l.ord_id = h.ord_id WHERE l.disc_pct >= 15.00 GROUP BY h.channel_cd ORDER BY total_qty DESC, h.channel_cd ASC

SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm, COUNT(o.ord_id) AS high_val_count FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id JOIN fx_rate f ON o.currency_cd = f.currency_cd AND o.ord_dt = f.eff_dt WHERE (o.ord_total_amt * f.rate_to_usd) > 500.00 GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm ORDER BY high_val_count DESC, c.cust_id ASC

SELECT c.tier_cd, AVG(o.ord_total_amt) AS avg_ord_amt FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE o.currency_cd = 'USD' GROUP BY c.tier_cd ORDER BY avg_ord_amt DESC, c.tier_cd ASC
SELECT tier_cd, COUNT(*) AS active_count, MIN(signup_dt) AS min_signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 GROUP BY tier_cd ORDER BY tier_cd ASC
SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm, p.categ_cd FROM prod_catalog p JOIN (SELECT sku FROM ord_line GROUP BY sku HAVING SUM(qty) > 5) l ON p.sku = l.sku ORDER BY p.sku ASC
SELECT region_cd, SUM(CASE WHEN signup_dt >= '2022-07-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_signups, COUNT(*) AS total_customers FROM cust_master GROUP BY region_cd ORDER BY recent_signups DESC
SELECT eff_dt, rate_to_usd FROM fx_rate WHERE currency_cd = 'EUR' AND eff_dt >= '2025-01-01' ORDER BY eff_dt ASC

SELECT o.ord_id, o.cust_id, o.ord_dt, o.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr o JOIN cust_master c ON o.cust_id = c.cust_id WHERE c.is_actv = 1 AND o.currency_cd = 'EUR' AND o.ord_dt >= '2026-07-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-07-31' ORDER BY o.ord_dt ASC, o.ord_id ASC

SELECT p.categ_cd, SUM(l.qty) AS total_units_sold, SUM(l.qty * l.unit_prc) AS total_revenue FROM ord_hdr o JOIN cust_master c ON o.cust_id = c.cust_id JOIN ord_line l ON o.ord_id = l.ord_id JOIN prod_catalog p ON l.sku = p.sku WHERE c.tier_cd = 'P' GROUP BY p.categ_cd ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, p.categ_cd ASC

SELECT o.ord_id, COUNT(l.line_no) AS line_count, SUM(l.qty) AS total_qty FROM ord_hdr o JOIN ord_line l ON o.ord_id = l.ord_id WHERE o.channel_cd = 'STR' GROUP BY o.ord_id HAVING COUNT(l.line_no) >= 3 ORDER BY line_count DESC, o.ord_id ASC

SELECT p.categ_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT p.sku) AS unique_skus, SUM(l.qty * l.unit_prc) AS total_revenue FROM ord_line l JOIN prod_catalog p ON l.sku = p.sku GROUP BY p.categ_cd HAVING total_revenue > 200.00 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, p.categ_cd ASC

SELECT DISTINCT o.ord_id, o.cust_id, o.ord_dt, o.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr o JOIN ord_line l ON o.ord_id = l.ord_id WHERE o.currency_cd = 'USD' AND l.disc_pct >= 15.00 ORDER BY o.ord_dt ASC, o.ord_id ASC

SELECT h.channel_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT c.cust_id) AS customer_count, AVG(h.ord_total_amt) AS avg_ord_amt FROM ord_hdr h JOIN cust_master c ON h.cust_id = c.cust_id WHERE c.tier_cd = 'S' AND c.region_cd = 'EU' GROUP BY h.channel_cd ORDER BY customer_count DESC, h.channel_cd ASC

SELECT categ_cd, MIN(list_prc) AS min_list_prc, MAX(list_prc) AS max_list_prc, AVG(list_prc) AS avg_list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE disc_flag = 0 GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY avg_list_prc DESC, categ_cd ASC

SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm, COUNT(o.ord_id) AS ord_count FROM ord_hdr o JOIN cust_master c ON o.cust_id = c.cust_id WHERE o.ord_total_amt > 500.00 AND o.channel_cd = 'WEB' AND o.ord_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-04-30' GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm ORDER BY ord_count DESC, c.cust_id ASC

SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm, COUNT(t.tkt_id) AS tkt_count FROM emp e JOIN support_tkt t ON e.emp_id = t.assigned_emp_id WHERE t.sev_lvl = 1 AND t.opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND t.opened_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY e.emp_id, e.emp_nm ORDER BY tkt_count DESC, e.emp_id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT t1.ord_id, t1.ord_dt, t1.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr t1 JOIN refund_req t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id WHERE t2.status_cd = 'A' AND t1.ord_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND t1.ord_dt <= '2026-04-30' ORDER BY t1.ord_total_amt DESC

SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm, COUNT(t2.ord_id) AS order_cnt FROM cust_master t1 JOIN ord_hdr t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.tier_cd = 'P' AND t2.ord_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND t2.ord_dt <= '2026-04-30' GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm ORDER BY order_cnt DESC

SELECT DISTINCT t1.tkt_id, t1.cust_id, t1.opened_ts FROM support_tkt t1 JOIN tkt_event t2 ON t1.tkt_id = t2.tkt_id WHERE t2.evt_type = 'ESCAL' AND t1.opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND t1.opened_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' ORDER BY t1.opened_ts ASC

SELECT t1.approver_emp_id, t2.emp_nm, COUNT(*) AS rfd_cnt FROM refund_req t1 JOIN emp t2 ON t1.approver_emp_id = t2.emp_id WHERE t1.reason_cd = 'DMG' AND t1.status_cd = 'A' AND t1.req_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND t1.req_dt <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY t1.approver_emp_id, t2.emp_nm ORDER BY rfd_cnt DESC
SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(*) AS tkt_cnt FROM support_tkt WHERE channel_cd = 'PHN' AND opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY tkt_cnt DESC
SELECT region_cd, COUNT(*) AS cust_cnt FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND signup_dt >= '2022-01-01' AND signup_dt <= '2022-12-31' GROUP BY region_cd ORDER BY cust_cnt DESC
SELECT reason_cd, COUNT(*) AS rfd_cnt FROM refund_req WHERE rfd_amt > 100.00 AND req_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND req_dt <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY reason_cd ORDER BY rfd_cnt DESC

SELECT t1.assigned_emp_id AS emp_id, t2.emp_nm, COUNT(*) AS tkt_cnt FROM support_tkt t1 JOIN emp t2 ON t1.assigned_emp_id = t2.emp_id WHERE t1.categ_cd = 'BILL' AND t1.closed_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND t1.closed_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY t1.assigned_emp_id, t2.emp_nm ORDER BY tkt_cnt DESC
SELECT method_cd, SUM(pay_amt) AS total_paid FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' AND paid_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND paid_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY method_cd ORDER BY total_paid DESC

SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm, COUNT(t2.tkt_id) AS closed_cnt FROM cust_master t1 JOIN support_tkt t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.closed_ts IS NOT NULL AND t2.opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm ORDER BY closed_cnt DESC
SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(*) AS ord_cnt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_status = 'R' AND ord_dt >= '2025-11-01' AND ord_dt <= '2025-11-30' GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY ord_cnt DESC

SELECT t1.ord_id, COUNT(t2.pay_id) AS pay_cnt FROM ord_hdr t1 JOIN payment t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id WHERE t1.ord_dt >= '2025-11-01' AND t1.ord_dt <= '2025-11-30' GROUP BY t1.ord_id HAVING COUNT(t2.pay_id) > 1 ORDER BY pay_cnt DESC

SELECT t1.sup_id, t2.sup_nm, COUNT(t1.sku) AS prod_cnt FROM prod_supplier t1 JOIN supplier t2 ON t1.sup_id = t2.sup_id WHERE t1.lead_days <= 7 AND t1.is_primary = 1 GROUP BY t1.sup_id, t2.sup_nm ORDER BY prod_cnt DESC

SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm, COUNT(t2.ord_id) AS ord_cnt FROM cust_master t1 JOIN cust_segment_hist t3 ON t1.cust_id = t3.cust_id JOIN ord_hdr t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t3.month_dt = '2025-11-01' AND t3.segment_cd = 'VIP' AND t2.ord_dt >= '2025-11-01' AND t2.ord_dt <= '2025-11-30' GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm ORDER BY ord_cnt DESC

SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm, SUM(t2.ord_total_amt) AS total_amt FROM cust_master t1 JOIN ord_hdr t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.channel_cd = 'APP' AND t2.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND t2.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm ORDER BY total_amt DESC
SELECT sku, wh_id, on_hand_qty, reorder_pt FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W1' AND on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt ORDER BY on_hand_qty ASC

SELECT t2.sku, t3.prod_nm, SUM(t2.qty) AS total_qty FROM ord_hdr t1 JOIN ord_line t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id JOIN prod_catalog t3 ON t2.sku = t3.sku WHERE t2.disc_pct > 0 AND t1.ord_dt >= '2025-11-01' AND t1.ord_dt <= '2025-11-30' GROUP BY t2.sku, t3.prod_nm ORDER BY total_qty DESC

SELECT DISTINCT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm, t1.signup_dt FROM cust_master t1 JOIN support_tkt t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.tier_cd = 'S' AND t2.sev_lvl = 1 AND t2.opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' ORDER BY t1.signup_dt ASC, t1.cust_id ASC
SELECT pay_id, ord_id, pay_amt FROM payment WHERE pay_amt > 200.00 AND currency_cd = 'USD' AND paid_ts >= '2025-11-12 00:00:00' AND paid_ts <= '2025-11-12 23:59:59' ORDER BY pay_amt DESC, pay_id ASC

SELECT wh_id, COUNT(*) AS late_shipment_cnt, AVG(DATEDIFF(deliv_dt, ship_dt)) AS avg_transit_days FROM shipment WHERE ship_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ship_dt <= '2026-01-31' AND deliv_dt IS NOT NULL AND deliv_dt > DATE_ADD(ship_dt, INTERVAL 5 DAY) GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY late_shipment_cnt DESC, wh_id ASC
SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE list_prc > 50.00 AND disc_flag = 0 AND categ_cd = 'ELC' ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku ASC

SELECT t1.ord_id, SUM(t1.pay_amt) AS total_settled FROM payment t1 WHERE t1.pay_status = 'S' AND t1.ord_id IN (SELECT ord_id FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'F') GROUP BY t1.ord_id ORDER BY total_settled DESC, t1.ord_id ASC
SELECT carrier_cd, COUNT(*) AS shipment_cnt FROM shipment WHERE wh_id = 'W2' AND deliv_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND deliv_dt <= '2026-03-31' GROUP BY carrier_cd ORDER BY shipment_cnt DESC, carrier_cd ASC
SELECT ord_id, cust_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd IN ('PHN', 'WEB') AND ord_total_amt > 300.00 AND currency_cd = 'USD' ORDER BY ord_dt ASC, ord_id ASC

SELECT l.ord_id, l.line_no, l.sku, l.unit_prc FROM ord_line l JOIN ord_hdr h ON l.ord_id = h.ord_id WHERE l.disc_pct >= 15.00 AND h.ord_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND h.ord_dt <= '2026-04-30' ORDER BY l.unit_prc DESC, l.ord_id ASC

SELECT tkt_id, cust_id, opened_ts, sev_lvl FROM support_tkt WHERE sev_lvl IN (1, 2) AND channel_cd = 'WEB' AND opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' ORDER BY sev_lvl ASC, opened_ts ASC
SELECT cust_id, COUNT(*) AS ticket_count FROM support_tkt GROUP BY cust_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY ticket_count DESC, cust_id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT s.sup_id, s.sup_nm, s.country FROM supplier s JOIN prod_supplier ps ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id JOIN prod_catalog p ON ps.sku = p.sku WHERE ps.is_primary = 1 AND p.list_prc > 100.00 ORDER BY s.sup_nm ASC, s.sup_id ASC
SELECT ord_id, COUNT(*) AS attempt_count FROM payment GROUP BY ord_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY attempt_count DESC, ord_id ASC

SELECT tkt_id, cust_id, opened_ts, closed_ts FROM support_tkt WHERE sev_lvl = 1 AND closed_ts IS NOT NULL AND opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' ORDER BY opened_ts ASC, tkt_id ASC
SELECT sku, SUM(qty) AS total_qty, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM ord_line WHERE qty >= 4 GROUP BY sku ORDER BY total_qty DESC, sku ASC

SELECT DISTINCT h.ord_id, h.cust_id, h.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr h JOIN refund_req r ON h.ord_id = r.ord_id WHERE r.status_cd = 'A' AND h.currency_cd = 'USD' ORDER BY h.ord_total_amt DESC, h.ord_id ASC
SELECT rfd_id, ord_id, req_dt, rfd_amt FROM refund_req WHERE rfd_amt > 70.00 AND reason_cd = 'DMG' ORDER BY rfd_amt DESC, rfd_id ASC
SELECT promo_id, promo_cd, promo_nm, disc_pct FROM promo WHERE starts_dt <= '2025-11-01' AND ends_dt >= '2025-11-30' ORDER BY disc_pct DESC, promo_id ASC
SELECT c.cust_nm, c.signup_dt FROM cust_master c JOIN cust_segment_hist s ON c.cust_id = s.cust_id WHERE s.segment_cd = 'RISK' AND s.month_dt = '2026-04-01' ORDER BY c.cust_nm ASC
SELECT promo_cd, promo_nm FROM promo WHERE starts_dt <= '2025-11-01' AND ends_dt >= '2025-11-30' ORDER BY promo_id ASC

SELECT session_id, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM web_event WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'CHECKOUT' AND channel_cd = 'WEB') AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY session_id ORDER BY event_count DESC, session_id ASC

SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm, COUNT(o.ord_id) AS order_count FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE c.tier_cd = 'P' GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm HAVING COUNT(o.ord_id) > 2 ORDER BY order_count DESC

SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'CART' AND cust_id IS NULL AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY event_count DESC

SELECT DISTINCT h.ord_id, h.ord_dt, h.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr h JOIN ord_line l ON h.ord_id = l.ord_id WHERE l.disc_pct >= 20.00 AND h.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND h.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' ORDER BY h.ord_dt ASC, h.ord_id ASC
SELECT ord_id, COUNT(promo_id) AS promo_count FROM ord_promo GROUP BY ord_id HAVING COUNT(promo_id) >= 2 ORDER BY promo_count DESC, ord_id ASC

SELECT p.promo_nm, h.ord_id, h.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr h JOIN ord_promo op ON h.ord_id = op.ord_id JOIN promo p ON op.promo_id = p.promo_id WHERE h.ord_dt >= '2025-12-01' AND h.ord_dt <= '2025-12-31' AND (p.promo_nm LIKE '%New%' OR p.promo_nm LIKE '%Holiday%' OR p.promo_nm LIKE '%Winter%' OR p.promo_nm LIKE '%December%' OR p.promo_nm LIKE '%Flash%' OR p.promo_nm LIKE '%Black%') ORDER BY h.ord_total_amt DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS converted_sessions FROM web_event WHERE session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'VIEW') AND session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'PURCHASE') AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59'
SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE region_cd = 'EU' AND tier_cd IN ('G', 'P') ORDER BY signup_dt ASC

SELECT cust_id, COUNT(*) AS event_count, MAX(ord_id) AS max_ord_id FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND channel_cd = 'APP' AND cust_id IS NOT NULL AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY cust_id ORDER BY event_count DESC

SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN cust_segment_hist s1 ON c.cust_id = s1.cust_id AND s1.month_dt = '2025-11-01' AND s1.segment_cd = 'REG' JOIN cust_segment_hist s2 ON c.cust_id = s2.cust_id AND s2.month_dt = '2025-12-01' AND s2.segment_cd = 'VIP' ORDER BY c.cust_id ASC

SELECT p.promo_id, p.promo_cd, SUM(h.ord_total_amt) AS total_order_sum FROM promo p JOIN ord_promo op ON p.promo_id = op.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr h ON op.ord_id = h.ord_id GROUP BY p.promo_id, p.promo_cd HAVING SUM(h.ord_total_amt) > 1000.00 ORDER BY total_order_sum DESC

SELECT c.cust_nm, s.month_dt FROM cust_segment_hist s JOIN cust_master c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id WHERE s.segment_cd = 'NEW' AND c.region_cd = 'AP' AND s.month_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND s.month_dt <= '2026-06-30' ORDER BY s.month_dt ASC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FROM web_event WHERE session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM web_event WHERE evt_ts >= '2025-11-01' AND evt_ts < '2025-12-01' GROUP BY session_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN evt_type = 'VIEW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN evt_type IN ('CART', 'CHECKOUT', 'PURCHASE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0)
SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN web_event w ON c.cust_id = w.cust_id WHERE c.tier_cd = 'P' AND w.evt_ts >= '2025-12-01' AND w.evt_ts < '2026-01-01' ORDER BY c.cust_nm ASC

SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE o.channel_cd IN ('WEB', 'APP') GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN o.channel_cd = 'WEB' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.channel_cd = 'APP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY c.cust_nm ASC
SELECT promo_id, promo_cd, promo_nm FROM promo WHERE DATEDIFF(ends_dt, starts_dt) > 90 ORDER BY promo_id ASC

SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT w.session_id) AS session_cnt FROM cust_master c JOIN web_event w ON c.cust_id = w.cust_id GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm HAVING session_cnt > 5 ORDER BY session_cnt DESC

SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm, o.ord_dt FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id JOIN ord_promo op ON o.ord_id = op.ord_id WHERE c.tier_cd = 'S' AND c.region_cd = 'LA' ORDER BY o.ord_dt ASC
SELECT c.cust_nm, c.signup_dt FROM cust_master c JOIN cust_segment_hist s ON c.cust_id = s.cust_id WHERE s.month_dt = '2026-03-01' AND s.segment_cd = 'RISK' ORDER BY c.cust_nm ASC, c.cust_id ASC
SELECT prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND disc_flag = 1 ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku ASC
SELECT s.sup_nm, ps.sku, ps.lead_days FROM prod_supplier ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.sup_id = s.sup_id WHERE ps.is_primary = 1 AND ps.lead_days > 30 ORDER BY ps.lead_days DESC
SELECT wh_id, sku, on_hand_qty, reorder_pt FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty < reorder_pt ORDER BY wh_id ASC, sku ASC
SELECT wh_id, wh_nm FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd = 'LA' ORDER BY wh_nm ASC
SELECT s.ship_id, s.ord_id, s.carrier_cd, s.deliv_dt FROM shipment s JOIN ord_hdr o ON s.ord_id = o.ord_id WHERE s.deliv_dt > '2025-11-10' ORDER BY s.deliv_dt ASC, s.ship_id ASC
SELECT pay_id, ord_id, pay_amt FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' AND pay_amt > 100 ORDER BY pay_amt DESC, pay_id ASC
SELECT ord_id, line_no, sku, qty FROM ord_line WHERE qty >= 4 ORDER BY qty DESC, ord_id ASC
SELECT p.prod_nm, l.ord_id, l.line_no, l.disc_pct FROM ord_line l JOIN prod_catalog p ON l.sku = p.sku WHERE l.disc_pct >= 15.00 ORDER BY l.disc_pct DESC, l.ord_id ASC
SELECT o.ord_id, o.ord_dt, o.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr o JOIN shipment s ON o.ord_id = s.ord_id WHERE o.ord_status = 'R' ORDER BY o.ord_dt DESC, o.ord_id ASC
SELECT tkt_id, cust_id, opened_ts FROM support_tkt WHERE categ_cd = 'SHIP' AND opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND assigned_emp_id IS NULL ORDER BY opened_ts ASC
SELECT o.ord_id, op.promo_id, o.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr o JOIN ord_promo op ON o.ord_id = op.ord_id JOIN promo p ON op.promo_id = p.promo_id WHERE p.disc_pct >= 20.00 ORDER BY o.ord_total_amt DESC
SELECT session_id, cust_id, evt_ts FROM web_event WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND evt_type = 'PURCHASE' ORDER BY evt_ts ASC
SELECT rfd_id, ord_id, req_dt, rfd_amt FROM refund_req WHERE status_cd = 'P' AND rfd_amt > 100 ORDER BY rfd_amt DESC
SELECT region_cd, COUNT(*) AS customer_cnt FROM cust_master WHERE tier_cd = 'P' AND is_actv = 1 GROUP BY region_cd ORDER BY customer_cnt DESC, region_cd ASC

SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm, SUM(l.qty) AS total_qty FROM prod_catalog p JOIN ord_line l ON p.sku = l.sku GROUP BY p.sku, p.prod_nm HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(l.ord_id, '-', l.line_no)) >= 3 ORDER BY total_qty DESC, p.sku ASC

SELECT o.ord_id, o.ord_dt, o.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr o JOIN payment p ON o.ord_id = p.ord_id GROUP BY o.ord_id, o.ord_dt, o.ord_total_amt HAVING COUNT(p.pay_id) > 1 ORDER BY o.ord_total_amt DESC, o.ord_id ASC
SELECT w.wh_id, w.wh_nm, SUM(i.on_hand_qty) AS total_qty FROM warehouse w JOIN inventory i ON w.wh_id = i.wh_id GROUP BY w.wh_id, w.wh_nm HAVING total_qty > 1500 ORDER BY total_qty DESC

SELECT s.sup_nm, COUNT(ps.sku) AS product_cnt FROM supplier s JOIN prod_supplier ps ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id WHERE ps.is_primary = 1 GROUP BY s.sup_id, s.sup_nm HAVING COUNT(ps.sku) >= 2 ORDER BY product_cnt DESC, s.sup_nm ASC

SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm, COUNT(r.rfd_id) AS rfd_cnt FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id JOIN refund_req r ON o.ord_id = r.ord_id GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm HAVING COUNT(r.rfd_id) >= 2 ORDER BY rfd_cnt DESC, c.cust_nm ASC

SELECT o.channel_cd, SUM(o.ord_total_amt * COALESCE(f.rate_to_usd, 1.0)) AS total_usd FROM ord_hdr o LEFT JOIN fx_rate f ON o.currency_cd = f.currency_cd AND f.eff_dt = '2026-07-01' WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-07-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-07-31' GROUP BY o.channel_cd
SELECT wh_id, COUNT(ship_id) AS ship_cnt FROM shipment WHERE ship_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY ship_cnt DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT l.sku, SUM(l.qty) AS total_qty FROM ord_hdr h JOIN ord_line l ON h.ord_id = l.ord_id WHERE h.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-01-31' GROUP BY l.sku HAVING SUM(l.qty) > 5 ORDER BY total_qty DESC

SELECT p.categ_cd, AVG(l.disc_pct) AS avg_disc_pct FROM ord_hdr h JOIN ord_line l ON h.ord_id = l.ord_id JOIN prod_catalog p ON l.sku = p.sku WHERE h.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-10-31' GROUP BY p.categ_cd
SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND region_cd = 'NA' AND signup_dt < '2022-07-01'
SELECT SUM(i.on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand FROM inventory i JOIN prod_catalog p ON i.sku = p.sku WHERE p.categ_cd = 'ELC'
SELECT carrier_cd, COUNT(ship_id) AS ship_cnt FROM shipment WHERE ship_dt BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY carrier_cd
SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(tkt_id) AS tkt_cnt FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts < '2026-05-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY channel_cd
SELECT reason_cd, SUM(rfd_amt) AS total_rfd_amt FROM refund_req WHERE req_dt BETWEEN '2025-10-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY reason_cd

SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id FROM cust_segment_hist c WHERE c.month_dt = '2025-12-01' AND c.segment_cd = 'VIP' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_hdr o WHERE o.cust_id = c.cust_id AND o.ord_dt BETWEEN '2025-11-01' AND '2025-11-30')

WITH ord_usd AS (SELECT c.tier_cd, o.ord_total_amt * COALESCE(f.rate_to_usd, 1.0) AS usd_amt FROM ord_hdr o JOIN cust_master c ON o.cust_id = c.cust_id LEFT JOIN fx_rate f ON o.currency_cd = f.currency_cd AND f.eff_dt = '2026-01-01' WHERE o.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-12-31') SELECT tier_cd, AVG(usd_amt) AS avg_usd_amt FROM ord_usd GROUP BY tier_cd ORDER BY avg_usd_amt DESC

WITH prod_qty AS (SELECT l.sku, SUM(l.qty) AS total_qty FROM ord_hdr h JOIN ord_line l ON h.ord_id = l.ord_id WHERE h.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-12-31' GROUP BY l.sku), avg_qty AS (SELECT AVG(total_qty) AS avg_q FROM prod_qty) SELECT p.sku, p.total_qty FROM prod_qty p, avg_qty a WHERE p.total_qty > a.avg_q
SELECT wh_id, COUNT(sku) AS distinct_sku_cnt FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id HAVING COUNT(sku) > 5
SELECT sup_id, COUNT(sku) AS product_cnt FROM prod_supplier GROUP BY sup_id HAVING COUNT(sku) > 2

SELECT op.promo_id, SUM(o.ord_total_amt * COALESCE(f.rate_to_usd, 1.0)) AS total_usd_rev FROM ord_hdr o JOIN ord_promo op ON o.ord_id = op.ord_id LEFT JOIN fx_rate f ON o.currency_cd = f.currency_cd AND f.eff_dt = '2026-01-01' WHERE o.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-12-31' GROUP BY op.promo_id

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN closed_ts IS NOT NULL AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, opened_ts, closed_ts) <= 24 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(tkt_id) AS pct_closed_within_24h FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts < '2026-05-01 00:00:00'

WITH nov_cust AS (SELECT DISTINCT cust_id FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt BETWEEN '2025-11-01' AND '2025-11-30'), apr_cust AS (SELECT DISTINCT cust_id FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30') SELECT n.cust_id FROM nov_cust n JOIN apr_cust a ON n.cust_id = a.cust_id

SELECT sku, SUM(ABS(qty)) AS total_units_moved FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'OUT' AND mv_ts BETWEEN '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND '2025-12-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY sku ORDER BY total_units_moved DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT o.channel_cd, AVG(o.ord_total_amt * COALESCE(f.rate_to_usd, 1.0)) AS avg_usd_amt FROM ord_hdr o LEFT JOIN fx_rate f ON o.currency_cd = f.currency_cd AND f.eff_dt = '2026-01-01' WHERE o.channel_cd IN ('WEB', 'APP') AND o.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-12-31' GROUP BY o.channel_cd

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status_cd = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approved_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status_cd = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS denied_count, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN status_cd = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN status_cd = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN status_cd = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) END AS ratio_approved_to_denied FROM refund_req WHERE req_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-01-31'
WITH wh_inv AS (SELECT wh_id, SUM(on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id) SELECT wh_id, total_on_hand FROM wh_inv ORDER BY total_on_hand DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN evt_type = 'VIEW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_views, SUM(CASE WHEN evt_type = 'PURCHASE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_purchases, (SUM(CASE WHEN evt_type = 'PURCHASE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN evt_type = 'VIEW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS conversion_percentage FROM web_event WHERE evt_ts BETWEEN '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND '2025-11-30 23:59:59'
SELECT tier_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) AS customer_count FROM cust_master WHERE signup_dt >= '2022-01-01' AND signup_dt <= '2022-12-31' GROUP BY tier_cd
SELECT e.emp_nm, e.mgr_emp_id FROM emp e JOIN code_lookup c ON e.dept_cd = c.code_val AND c.code_type = 'DEPT' WHERE c.code_desc LIKE '%management%' OR e.dept_cd = 'MGT'
SELECT cust_nm, tier_cd FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND region_cd = 'AP'
SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND currency_cd = 'USD'
SELECT rfd_id, rfd_amt, reason_cd FROM refund_req WHERE status_cd = 'P'
SELECT tkt_id, sev_lvl, opened_ts FROM support_tkt WHERE closed_ts IS NULL AND categ_cd = 'BILL'
SELECT prod_nm, list_prc, categ_cd FROM prod_catalog WHERE disc_flag = 1 AND categ_cd = 'ELC'
SELECT wh_nm, region_cd FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd = 'NA'
SELECT promo_nm, disc_pct FROM promo WHERE '2025-11-15' BETWEEN starts_dt AND ends_dt
SELECT ord_status, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_sum FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY ord_status ORDER BY total_sum DESC
SELECT c.cust_nm, COUNT(t.tkt_id) AS tkt_cnt FROM cust_master c JOIN support_tkt t ON c.cust_id = t.cust_id GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm HAVING COUNT(t.tkt_id) > 2 ORDER BY tkt_cnt DESC

SELECT e.emp_nm, COUNT(t.tkt_id) AS tkt_cnt FROM emp e JOIN code_lookup c ON e.dept_cd = c.code_val AND c.code_type = 'DEPT' LEFT JOIN support_tkt t ON e.emp_id = t.assigned_emp_id WHERE c.code_desc LIKE '%support%' OR e.dept_cd = 'SUP' GROUP BY e.emp_id, e.emp_nm
SELECT reason_cd, AVG(rfd_amt) AS avg_rfd_amt FROM refund_req WHERE status_cd = 'A' GROUP BY reason_cd
SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(ord_id) AS order_count, AVG(ord_total_amt) AS avg_order_total FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY channel_cd
SELECT h.cust_id, COUNT(p.pay_id) AS pay_cnt FROM payment p JOIN ord_hdr h ON p.ord_id = h.ord_id WHERE p.method_cd = 'CC' GROUP BY h.cust_id
SELECT categ_cd, AVG(list_prc) AS avg_price FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd HAVING AVG(list_prc) > 30

SELECT c.cust_nm, o.ord_id FROM ord_hdr o JOIN cust_master c ON o.cust_id = c.cust_id WHERE o.ord_total_amt > (SELECT AVG(ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31')

SELECT tkt_id, categ_cd FROM support_tkt WHERE closed_ts IS NOT NULL AND opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, opened_ts, closed_ts) > (SELECT AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, opened_ts, closed_ts)) FROM support_tkt WHERE closed_ts IS NOT NULL AND opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00')

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status_cd = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approved_count, COUNT(*) AS total_decided_count, (SUM(CASE WHEN status_cd = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS approval_percentage FROM refund_req WHERE req_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND req_dt <= '2025-12-31' AND status_cd IN ('A', 'D')
SELECT c.tier_cd, AVG(o.ord_total_amt) AS avg_amt FROM ord_hdr o JOIN cust_master c ON o.cust_id = c.cust_id WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY c.tier_cd
SELECT w.wh_nm, SUM(l.qty) AS total_shipped FROM shipment s JOIN warehouse w ON s.wh_id = w.wh_id JOIN ord_line l ON s.ord_id = l.ord_id GROUP BY w.wh_id, w.wh_nm ORDER BY total_shipped DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN evt_type = 'VIEW' THEN session_id END) AS view_sessions, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN evt_type = 'CART' THEN session_id END) AS cart_sessions, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN evt_type = 'CHECKOUT' THEN session_id END) AS checkout_sessions, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN evt_type = 'PURCHASE' THEN session_id END) AS purchase_sessions FROM web_event WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB'

SELECT sev_lvl, SUM(CASE WHEN opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS april_count, SUM(CASE WHEN opened_ts >= '2026-05-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts <= '2026-05-31 23:59:59' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS may_count FROM support_tkt WHERE (opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59') OR (opened_ts >= '2026-05-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts <= '2026-05-31 23:59:59') GROUP BY sev_lvl

SELECT e.emp_nm, SUM(r.rfd_amt) AS total_approved FROM refund_req r JOIN emp e ON r.approver_emp_id = e.emp_id WHERE r.status_cd = 'A' AND r.decided_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND r.decided_dt <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY e.emp_id, e.emp_nm ORDER BY total_approved DESC
SELECT w.wh_id, w.wh_nm, COUNT(i.sku) FROM warehouse w JOIN inventory i ON w.wh_id = i.wh_id WHERE w.wh_nm LIKE '%Newark Hub%' GROUP BY w.wh_id, w.wh_nm
SELECT method_cd, SUM(pay_amt) FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' AND paid_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND paid_ts < '2025-12-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY method_cd
SELECT ord_status, SUM(ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY ord_status
SELECT sku, SUM(qty) AS total_qty FROM ord_line GROUP BY sku HAVING SUM(qty) > 5
SELECT carrier_cd, COUNT(*) AS shipment_count FROM shipment WHERE ship_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ship_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY carrier_cd
SELECT sku, SUM(qty) FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'ADJ' GROUP BY sku
SELECT wh_id, SUM(on_hand_qty) FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id HAVING SUM(on_hand_qty) > 1000
SELECT ord_id, COUNT(*) FROM payment GROUP BY ord_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
SELECT DISTINCT p.sku, p.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog p JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE i.on_hand_qty <= i.reorder_pt ORDER BY p.sku ASC
SELECT channel_cd, AVG(ord_total_amt) FROM (SELECT channel_cd, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr) AS t GROUP BY channel_cd HAVING AVG(ord_total_amt) > 200
SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN carrier_cd = 'DHL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(*) FROM shipment WHERE ship_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ship_dt <= '2026-12-31'
WITH wh_stock AS (SELECT wh_id, SUM(on_hand_qty) AS total_stock FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id) SELECT wh_id, total_stock FROM wh_stock ORDER BY total_stock DESC
WITH channel_sales AS (SELECT channel_cd, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_sales FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY channel_cd) SELECT channel_cd, total_sales FROM channel_sales WHERE total_sales > 500

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS total_sessions, SUM(CASE WHEN evt_type = 'VIEW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_views, SUM(CASE WHEN evt_type = 'PURCHASE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_purchases FROM web_event

WITH high_price AS (SELECT sku FROM prod_catalog WHERE list_prc > 50), moved_out AS (SELECT DISTINCT sku FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'OUT') SELECT hp.sku FROM high_price hp JOIN moved_out mo ON hp.sku = mo.sku

WITH pay_stats AS (SELECT currency_cd, SUM(CASE WHEN pay_status = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successes, COUNT(*) AS attempts FROM payment GROUP BY currency_cd) SELECT currency_cd, successes / attempts AS success_ratio FROM pay_stats
SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_total_amt > (SELECT AVG(ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr)
WITH wh_totals AS (SELECT wh_id, SUM(on_hand_qty) AS total_units FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id) SELECT wh_id, total_units FROM wh_totals ORDER BY total_units DESC LIMIT 1
WITH line_prod AS (SELECT l.qty, p.categ_cd FROM ord_line l JOIN prod_catalog p ON l.sku = p.sku) SELECT categ_cd, AVG(qty) FROM line_prod GROUP BY categ_cd
SELECT wh_id, SUM(qty) FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'IN' GROUP BY wh_id HAVING SUM(qty) > 100
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ship_status = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM shipment

WITH cat_avg AS (SELECT categ_cd, AVG(list_prc) AS avg_prc FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd) SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog p JOIN cat_avg c ON p.categ_cd = c.categ_cd WHERE p.list_prc > c.avg_prc
SELECT h.ord_id, h.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr h JOIN payment p ON h.ord_id = p.ord_id WHERE p.method_cd = 'CC' AND h.ord_total_amt > 300

SELECT p.promo_cd, COUNT(op.ord_id) FROM promo p JOIN ord_promo op ON p.promo_id = op.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr h ON op.ord_id = h.ord_id WHERE h.ord_dt BETWEEN '2025-11-01' AND '2025-11-30' GROUP BY p.promo_cd ORDER BY COUNT(op.ord_id) DESC, p.promo_cd ASC
SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN cust_segment_hist s ON c.cust_id = s.cust_id WHERE c.is_actv = 1 AND s.month_dt = '2026-10-01' AND s.segment_cd = 'VIP' ORDER BY c.cust_nm
SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY event_cnt DESC
SELECT tier_cd, COUNT(*) AS actv_cust_cnt FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 GROUP BY tier_cd ORDER BY tier_cd

SELECT p.promo_cd, SUM(o.ord_total_amt) AS total_ord_amt FROM promo p JOIN ord_promo op ON p.promo_id = op.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr o ON op.ord_id = o.ord_id WHERE p.starts_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND p.starts_dt <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY p.promo_cd ORDER BY total_ord_amt DESC

SELECT session_id, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM web_event WHERE evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY session_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ORDER BY event_cnt DESC, session_id

SELECT p.promo_cd, AVG(o.ord_total_amt) AS avg_ord_amt FROM promo p JOIN ord_promo op ON p.promo_id = op.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr o ON op.ord_id = o.ord_id GROUP BY p.promo_cd HAVING AVG(o.ord_total_amt) > 300 ORDER BY avg_ord_amt DESC
SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN cust_segment_hist s ON c.cust_id = s.cust_id WHERE c.region_cd = 'AP' AND s.month_dt = '2026-08-01' AND s.segment_cd = 'RISK' ORDER BY c.cust_id
SELECT p.promo_nm, COUNT(op.ord_id) AS ord_cnt FROM promo p JOIN ord_promo op ON p.promo_id = op.promo_id GROUP BY p.promo_id, p.promo_nm HAVING COUNT(op.ord_id) > 2 ORDER BY ord_cnt DESC

SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) AS cust_cnt FROM web_event WHERE cust_id IS NOT NULL AND evt_ts >= '2025-12-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts <= '2025-12-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY cust_cnt DESC

SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN web_event w ON c.cust_id = w.cust_id WHERE w.evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND w.evt_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN w.evt_type = 'VIEW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN w.evt_type = 'PURCHASE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY c.cust_nm

SELECT c.tier_cd, SUM(o.ord_total_amt) AS total_amt FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE o.currency_cd = 'USD' AND o.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY c.tier_cd ORDER BY total_amt DESC

SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN cust_segment_hist s1 ON c.cust_id = s1.cust_id AND s1.month_dt = '2026-05-01' AND s1.segment_cd = 'REG' JOIN cust_segment_hist s2 ON c.cust_id = s2.cust_id AND s2.month_dt = '2026-06-01' AND s2.segment_cd = 'VIP' ORDER BY c.cust_nm

SELECT channel_cd, SUM(CASE WHEN evt_type = 'CART' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cart_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN evt_type = 'PURCHASE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_cnt, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN evt_type = 'CART' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN evt_type = 'PURCHASE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN evt_type = 'CART' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) END AS ratio FROM web_event WHERE evt_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts <= '2025-12-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY ratio DESC

SELECT p.promo_nm, SUM(o.ord_total_amt) AS total_sales FROM promo p JOIN ord_promo op ON p.promo_id = op.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr o ON op.ord_id = o.ord_id WHERE o.currency_cd = 'USD' AND o.ord_dt >= '2025-11-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-03-31' GROUP BY p.promo_id, p.promo_nm ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT o.ord_id) AS promo_ord_cnt FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id JOIN ord_promo op ON o.ord_id = op.ord_id WHERE o.currency_cd = 'USD' AND o.ord_total_amt > 500.00 GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm ORDER BY promo_ord_cnt DESC
SELECT channel_cd, evt_type, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM web_event WHERE evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY channel_cd, evt_type ORDER BY event_cnt DESC

SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN web_event w ON c.cust_id = w.cust_id WHERE w.evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND w.evt_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59' AND w.channel_cd IN ('WEB', 'APP') GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN w.channel_cd = 'WEB' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN w.channel_cd = 'APP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY c.cust_nm
SELECT s.segment_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT s.cust_id) AS cust_cnt FROM cust_segment_hist s WHERE s.month_dt = '2026-10-01' GROUP BY s.segment_cd ORDER BY cust_cnt DESC

SELECT p.promo_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT o.cust_id) AS unique_cust_cnt FROM promo p JOIN ord_promo op ON p.promo_id = op.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr o ON op.ord_id = o.ord_id WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY p.promo_id, p.promo_nm ORDER BY unique_cust_cnt DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(evt_ts, '%Y-%m') AS month_str, COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) AS active_cust_cnt FROM web_event WHERE cust_id IS NOT NULL AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts <= '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(evt_ts, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month_str

SELECT p.sku, SUM(ABS(m.qty)) AS total_units FROM prod_catalog p JOIN inv_move m ON p.sku = m.sku WHERE p.categ_cd = 'ELC' AND m.mv_type = 'OUT' AND m.mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY p.sku ORDER BY total_units DESC, p.sku ASC
SELECT wh_id, COUNT(*) AS item_cnt FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty < reorder_pt GROUP BY wh_id

SELECT s.sup_id, s.sup_nm, COUNT(*) AS primary_cnt FROM supplier s JOIN prod_supplier ps ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id WHERE ps.is_primary = 1 GROUP BY s.sup_id, s.sup_nm HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY primary_cnt DESC, s.sup_id ASC

SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog p JOIN prod_supplier ps ON p.sku = ps.sku WHERE ps.sup_id = 1 AND ps.lead_days > (SELECT AVG(ps2.lead_days) FROM prod_supplier ps2 WHERE ps2.sup_id = 1) ORDER BY p.sku ASC
SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'HOM' ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT t1.sup_id, AVG(t1.lead_days) AS avg_lead_days FROM prod_supplier t1 JOIN prod_catalog t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t2.categ_cd = 'KIT' GROUP BY t1.sup_id ORDER BY avg_lead_days DESC, t1.sup_id ASC
SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE list_prc > (SELECT AVG(list_prc) FROM prod_catalog) ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku ASC
SELECT t1.wh_id, t1.wh_nm FROM warehouse t1 JOIN inventory t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id GROUP BY t1.wh_id, t1.wh_nm HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t2.sku) > 5 ORDER BY t1.wh_id ASC
SELECT t1.sku, SUM(t2.on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand FROM prod_catalog t1 JOIN inventory t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t1.disc_flag = 1 GROUP BY t1.sku ORDER BY total_on_hand DESC, t1.sku ASC
SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(*) AS prod_count FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY categ_cd ASC

SELECT t1.sup_id, t1.sup_nm FROM supplier t1 JOIN prod_supplier t2 ON t1.sup_id = t2.sup_id JOIN prod_catalog t3 ON t2.sku = t3.sku WHERE t3.categ_cd IN ('ELC', 'HOM', 'KIT', 'OFC') GROUP BY t1.sup_id, t1.sup_nm HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t3.categ_cd) = 4 ORDER BY t1.sup_id ASC

SELECT t1.sku, t1.prod_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.sup_id) AS supplier_cnt FROM prod_catalog t1 JOIN prod_supplier t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku GROUP BY t1.sku, t1.prod_nm HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t2.sup_id) >= 2 ORDER BY supplier_cnt DESC, t1.sku ASC
SELECT wh_id, SUM(ABS(qty)) AS total_adj_qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'ADJ' AND mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY total_adj_qty DESC, wh_id ASC
SELECT t1.sku, t1.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog t1 JOIN inventory t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t1.list_prc > 100.00 AND t2.wh_id = 'W1' ORDER BY t1.list_prc DESC, t1.sku ASC
SELECT region_cd, COUNT(*) AS warehouse_count FROM warehouse GROUP BY region_cd ORDER BY region_cd ASC
SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT t1.sup_id, t1.sup_nm, MAX(t2.lead_days) AS max_lead_days FROM supplier t1 JOIN prod_supplier t2 ON t1.sup_id = t2.sup_id GROUP BY t1.sup_id, t1.sup_nm ORDER BY max_lead_days DESC, t1.sup_id ASC
SELECT t1.sku, SUM(t1.qty) AS total_qty FROM ord_line t1 GROUP BY t1.sku HAVING SUM(t1.qty) > 10 ORDER BY total_qty DESC, t1.sku ASC

SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm, (p.list_prc - c.avg_prc) AS price_diff FROM prod_catalog p JOIN (SELECT categ_cd, AVG(list_prc) AS avg_prc FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd) c ON p.categ_cd = c.categ_cd WHERE p.list_prc > c.avg_prc ORDER BY price_diff DESC, p.sku ASC
SELECT wh_id, SUM(CASE WHEN on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS low_stock_ratio FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY low_stock_ratio DESC, wh_id ASC

SELECT s.sup_id, s.sup_nm FROM supplier s JOIN prod_supplier ps ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id JOIN prod_catalog p ON ps.sku = p.sku GROUP BY s.sup_id, s.sup_nm HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN p.categ_cd = 'ELC' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND AVG(ps.lead_days) < 30 ORDER BY s.sup_id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT p.sku, p.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog p JOIN inv_move m ON p.sku = m.sku GROUP BY p.sku, p.prod_nm HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN m.mv_type = 'IN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN m.mv_type = 'OUT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY p.sku ASC

SELECT DISTINCT p.sku, p.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog p JOIN ord_line l ON p.sku = l.sku JOIN ord_hdr h ON l.ord_id = h.ord_id WHERE h.channel_cd = 'APP' AND p.sku IN (SELECT l2.sku FROM ord_line l2 JOIN ord_hdr h2 ON l2.ord_id = h2.ord_id WHERE h2.channel_cd = 'PHN') ORDER BY p.sku ASC

SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id WHERE c.region_cd IN ('NA', 'EU') GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.region_cd) >= 2 ORDER BY c.cust_id ASC

SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c WHERE c.tier_cd = 'P' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_hdr h JOIN refund_req r ON h.ord_id = r.ord_id WHERE h.cust_id = c.cust_id) ORDER BY c.cust_id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT p.sku, p.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog p JOIN ord_line l ON p.sku = l.sku JOIN ord_hdr h ON l.ord_id = h.ord_id JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE p.categ_cd = 'KIT' AND i.on_hand_qty > 300 ORDER BY p.sku ASC

SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id JOIN payment p ON h.ord_id = p.ord_id WHERE p.method_cd IN ('CC', 'PP') GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm, h.ord_id, h.ord_total_amt HAVING h.ord_total_amt > 500.00 ORDER BY c.cust_id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN support_tkt t ON c.cust_id = t.cust_id JOIN ord_hdr h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id WHERE t.categ_cd = 'BILL' AND h.channel_cd = 'STR' ORDER BY c.cust_id ASC
SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE tier_cd = 'S' AND region_cd = 'LA' AND signup_dt > '2022-07-01';
SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE currency_cd <> 'USD' AND ord_total_amt > 200;
SELECT wh_id, wh_nm FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd <> 'NA';
SELECT sku, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE disc_flag = 1 AND categ_cd = 'ELC';
SELECT promo_id, promo_nm FROM promo WHERE disc_pct >= 20;
SELECT cust_id, email_addr FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND region_cd = 'AP';
SELECT tkt_id, sev_lvl FROM support_tkt WHERE closed_ts IS NULL AND sev_lvl = 2;
SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, tier_cd FROM cust_master WHERE tier_cd = 'G' ORDER BY cust_nm ASC;
SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog ORDER BY list_prc DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-04-30' ORDER BY ord_dt DESC, ord_id ASC;
SELECT sku, prod_nm, categ_cd FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd <> 'ELC' ORDER BY categ_cd ASC, prod_nm ASC;

SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id JOIN support_tkt s ON c.cust_id = s.cust_id WHERE o.channel_cd = 'WEB' AND o.ord_dt = '2026-04-03' AND DATE(s.opened_ts) = '2026-04-03' ORDER BY c.cust_id ASC;

SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE o.channel_cd = 'APP' AND c.cust_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT ord_hdr.cust_id FROM ord_hdr JOIN refund_req ON ord_hdr.ord_id = refund_req.ord_id) ORDER BY c.cust_nm ASC;

SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o1 ON c.cust_id = o1.cust_id AND o1.channel_cd = 'WEB' JOIN ord_hdr o2 ON c.cust_id = o2.cust_id AND o2.channel_cd = 'APP' ORDER BY c.cust_id ASC;

SELECT DISTINCT p.sku, p.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog p JOIN ord_line l1 ON p.sku = l1.sku JOIN ord_hdr o1 ON l1.ord_id = o1.ord_id AND o1.currency_cd = 'USD' JOIN ord_line l2 ON p.sku = l2.sku JOIN ord_hdr o2 ON l2.ord_id = o2.ord_id AND o2.currency_cd = 'EUR' ORDER BY p.sku ASC;
SELECT DISTINCT p.sku, p.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog p JOIN ord_line l ON p.sku = l.sku WHERE p.sku NOT IN (SELECT sku FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'ADJ') ORDER BY p.prod_nm ASC;
SELECT DISTINCT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm FROM emp e JOIN refund_req r ON e.emp_id = r.approver_emp_id WHERE r.reason_cd = 'DMG' ORDER BY e.emp_id ASC;
SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(*) AS ticket_count FROM support_tkt WHERE sev_lvl <= 2 GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY ticket_count DESC;
SELECT reason_cd, SUM(rfd_amt) AS total_rfd_amt FROM refund_req WHERE status_cd = 'P' GROUP BY reason_cd ORDER BY total_rfd_amt DESC;
SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(*) AS tkt_count FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY tkt_count DESC;
SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND disc_flag = 0 ORDER BY list_prc DESC;
-- UNANSWERABLE: The finance department code is not specified in the code_lookup table for DEPT.
SELECT wh_id, wh_nm, region_cd FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd = 'AP' ORDER BY wh_nm ASC;
SELECT rfd_id, ord_id, rfd_amt FROM refund_req WHERE status_cd = 'A' ORDER BY req_dt DESC;
SELECT promo_id, promo_cd, promo_nm FROM promo WHERE starts_dt >= '2025-11-01' ORDER BY starts_dt ASC;
SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'STR' AND ord_status = 'D' ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC;
SELECT tkt_id, cust_id, sev_lvl FROM support_tkt WHERE categ_cd = 'SHIP' AND sev_lvl = 3 ORDER BY opened_ts ASC;

SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE o.ord_dt = '2026-04-03' UNION SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN support_tkt t ON c.cust_id = t.cust_id WHERE DATE(t.opened_ts) = '2026-04-03' ORDER BY cust_nm;

SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM emp WHERE emp_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT mgr_emp_id FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NOT NULL) OR emp_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT approver_emp_id FROM refund_req WHERE approver_emp_id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY emp_id;
SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE c.tier_cd = 'G' GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm HAVING COUNT(o.ord_id) >= 2 ORDER BY c.cust_id;
SELECT DISTINCT p.sku, p.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog p JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE i.on_hand_qty <= i.reorder_pt ORDER BY p.sku;
SELECT wh_nm, region_cd FROM warehouse;
SELECT DISTINCT s.carrier_cd FROM shipment s JOIN warehouse w ON s.wh_id = w.wh_id WHERE w.wh_nm = 'Newark Hub';
SELECT pay_id, pay_amt FROM payment WHERE method_cd = 'CC' AND pay_status = 'S' AND paid_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00';
SELECT ship_id, ship_dt FROM shipment WHERE wh_id = 'W2' AND carrier_cd IN ('DHL', 'FDX');
SELECT sku, SUM(qty) AS total_movement_qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'ADJ' GROUP BY sku;
SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND currency_cd = 'USD' AND ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-01-31';
SELECT w.wh_nm, COUNT(s.ship_id) AS shipment_count FROM warehouse w JOIN shipment s ON w.wh_id = s.wh_id WHERE s.deliv_dt IS NOT NULL GROUP BY w.wh_id, w.wh_nm;
SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog p WHERE p.sku IN (SELECT sku FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'IN') AND p.sku IN (SELECT sku FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'OUT');
SELECT method_cd, SUM(pay_amt) AS total_settled_amount FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' GROUP BY method_cd;

SELECT sku, wh_id, MAX(mv_ts) AS mv_ts FROM inv_move GROUP BY sku, wh_id

SELECT s.sup_nm, ps.sku FROM prod_supplier ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.sup_id = s.sup_id JOIN (SELECT sup_id, AVG(lead_days) AS avg_lead FROM prod_supplier GROUP BY sup_id) avg_tbl ON ps.sup_id = avg_tbl.sup_id WHERE ps.lead_days > avg_tbl.avg_lead ORDER BY s.sup_nm, ps.sku
SELECT i1.sku, i1.on_hand_qty FROM inventory i1 JOIN (SELECT sku, AVG(on_hand_qty) AS avg_qty FROM inventory GROUP BY sku) i2 ON i1.sku = i2.sku WHERE i1.wh_id = 'W1' AND i1.on_hand_qty > i2.avg_qty

SELECT s.sup_id, s.sup_nm FROM supplier s WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prod_supplier ps JOIN prod_catalog pc ON ps.sku = pc.sku WHERE ps.sup_id = s.sup_id AND pc.list_prc > 100) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prod_supplier ps JOIN prod_catalog pc ON ps.sku = pc.sku WHERE ps.sup_id = s.sup_id AND pc.categ_cd = 'KIT')

SELECT i.sku, i.wh_id FROM inventory i JOIN (SELECT sku, wh_id, SUM(ABS(qty)) AS total_out FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'OUT' GROUP BY sku, wh_id) m ON i.sku = m.sku AND i.wh_id = m.wh_id WHERE i.on_hand_qty > m.total_out

SELECT m1.sku, m1.wh_id, MAX(ABS(m1.qty)) AS max_abs_qty FROM inv_move m1 JOIN (SELECT mv_type, AVG(ABS(qty)) AS avg_qty FROM inv_move GROUP BY mv_type) m2 ON m1.mv_type = m2.mv_type WHERE ABS(m1.qty) > m2.avg_qty GROUP BY m1.sku, m1.wh_id ORDER BY m1.sku, m1.wh_id
